description.en: Local-first character archive in the DSH sidebar: it interviews you about someone and writes the answers into Markdown cards, imports SillyTavern character cards, writes a novel chapter by chapter, and roleplays with a card plus its world book; anything written into a card has to be quotable from material you wrote.
description.zh: 侧边栏里的本地优先人物档案：访谈你身边的人并写成 Markdown 卡，能导入酒馆角色卡，也能逐章写小说、拿角色卡和世界书演一段；写进卡的每一条都要能在你写过的材料里找到原句。

description.en: Right-side message navigation rail for DeepSeek Harness: per-message tick marks, hover-to-expand preview drawer, smooth jump to any historical message, star bookmarks, realtime slide animation with interrupt support, full session index with virtualization, dynamic panel avoidance, official --dsw-* token styling.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 右侧消息导航轨道：逐条消息刻度、悬浮预览抽屉、平滑跳转、星标回看、实时平移动画（可打断）、完整会话索引与虚拟化、面板动态避让、官方 --dsw-* token 样式。

description.en: Six independently togglable modules in one DSH plugin: per-turn CNY cost, DeepSeek account balance, PDF/Word/Excel/CSV read-write tools with right-sidebar preview, a compiler/runtime environment registry, and run/build tools that execute a program or an MSBuild project by environment id. Toolchain paths are resolved at run time (Visual Studio install-root scan, %ProgramFiles%, PATH) and can be overridden per environment through plugin config, so nothing is pinned to the author's machine.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 插件里的六个可独立开关的模块：每轮对话的人民币成本、DeepSeek 账户余额、PDF/Word/Excel/CSV 直接读写工具与右栏预览、编译/运行环境表，以及按环境名执行程序或编译 MSBuild 工程的 run/build 工具。工具链路径在运行时解析（扫描 Visual Studio 安装根、%ProgramFiles%、PATH），并可在插件配置里逐个环境覆盖，没有写死在作者机器上的路径。

description.en: One screen for every work you have shipped: local project facts, GitHub stars and last push, whether the plugin market has picked it up and how many downloads it has, plus pending pull-request wait times against the upstream median.
description.zh: 一屏看清每个作品的现状：本地版本与文件数、GitHub star 与最后推送、市场是否已收录及下载量、收录 PR 等待时长对比上游中位数；全部只读、数字都来自 API，不经模型生成。

description.en: Durable cross-session memory plus a fetch ladder that survives hostname-keyed blocking. Four tools: memory_recall, memory_save and memory_stats over a plain-JSON fact store at $DSH_HOME/memory/facts.json, plus resilient_fetch which tries plain fetch, then a same-service alias host (Wikipedia only for now), then curl over IPv6 and IPv4 (needs curl on PATH). No daemon, no npm dependency, no network at import time. (1.3.0 shipped a fifth tool, memory_prune; it was withdrawn in 1.4.0 because adding a tool to a running plugin breaks sessions that were opened before it.)
description.zh: 跨会话持久记忆，加一条绕开主机名级封锁的取数阶梯：四个工具——memory_recall / memory_save / memory_stats 读写 $DSH_HOME/memory/facts.json 里的纯 JSON，resilient_fetch 依次尝试直连 fetch → 同服务别名主机（目前仅 Wikipedia）→ curl IPv6 → curl IPv4（curl 需在 PATH 上）。无后台进程、无 npm 依赖、导入期不联网。（1.3.0 曾加入第五个工具 memory_prune，已在 1.4.0 撤下：给运行中的插件加工具，会让此前打开的会话报错。）

description.en: A judgment core for DeepSeek Harness: a cognition loop that gives every decision a source and attribution and drives planning to a close, hippocampus memory that condenses running experience into knowledge (journal ledger, episodic archive, low-confidence decay), judgment identity responsibilities in the architecture (consistent rubric, judgment bound to its source), and an A2A memory-management team via dsh-linghun-assembler. Requires DSH ^0.1.0-rc.7 (rc.2 supported).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的判断内核：认知循环让判断有来处、反馈有归因、规划收口；海马体把运行经历沉淀为可复用知识（序时账留痕、情景归档、低置信降权遗忘）；判分身份职责入架构（口径一致、判据绑定来源）；联动 dsh-linghun-assembler 的 A2A 记忆管理团队。需要 DSH ^0.1.0-rc.7（支持 rc.2）。

description.en: Android companion bridge: QR-code LAN pairing with revocable device tokens and TLS fingerprints, a phone-connection and device-management panel, and an HTTPS access proxy serving sessions, live events and approvals to the paired native app.
description.zh: Android 配套桥接：局域网扫码配对（可吊销的设备 Token 与 TLS 指纹）、手机连接与设备管理面板，以及向配对原生 App 提供会话、实时事件与审批的 HTTPS 接入代理。

description.en: One toggle makes the whole DeepSeek Harness shell translucent, with an opacity slider and a custom full-page background.
description.zh: 一键让整个 DeepSeek Harness 界面通透起来：透明度滑块随心调，背景图自由换。

description.en: Draggable 3D liquid-glass floating card for the DSH web GUI: DeepSeek API balance, cumulative spend/token stats (today/yesterday/7d/30d/all), adjustable glass/3D/color controls, and one-click top-up.
description.zh: DSH 网页右上角可拖动 3D 液态玻璃余额卡片：显示 DeepSeek API 余额、累计消费与 Token 统计（今天/昨天/近7天/近30天/全部），玻璃参数/3D 厚度/颜色均可调，内置官方充值入口。

description.en: Liquid Glass refraction input card for the DSH web GUI, with coupled-spring press animation. Published on npm: dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-liquid-glass-input.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web GUI 输入卡加上液态玻璃折射效果与弹簧按压动画。已发布 npm：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-liquid-glass-input。

description.en: Academic literature search and citation tools for DeepSeek Harness: paper search via Crossref and OpenAlex with no API key, related-works discovery, and citation formatting in GB/T 7714, APA and BibTeX.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的学术文献检索与引用工具：基于 Crossref 与 OpenAlex 检索论文（无需 API key），支持相关工作发现，并可按 GB/T 7714、APA 与 BibTeX 格式生成引用。

description.en: Ten live-data tools over eight keyless public APIs: FX rates, weather, npm/PyPI versions, GitHub repo stats, Bilibili video stats, A-share/index/gold quotes, and IP geolocation. Tool defaults are configurable in settings.
description.zh: 10 个实时数据工具，覆盖 8 个免密钥公开接口：汇率、天气、npm/PyPI 包版本、GitHub 仓库信息、B站视频数据、A股/大盘/金价行情、IP 归属地；默认参数可在设置面板配置。

description.en: Live2D avatar stage and desktop companion for DSH: bundled Haru sample, custom Cubism 2/3+ model loading with scale and position controls, a draggable in-page pet, an optional transparent always-on-top desktop pet window, per-conversation expression prompt control, and opt-in voice with self-hosted ASR/TTS.
description.zh: DSH 的 Live2D 形象舞台与桌宠：内置 Haru 示例、自定义 Cubism 2/3+ 模型加载与缩放/位置控制、页面内可拖动桌宠、可选透明置顶桌面独立桌宠窗口、按对话授权的表情 control prompt，以及默认关闭、需自部署 ASR/TTS 的语音功能。

description.en: Live2D desk pet overlay for the DSH web GUI: mirrors agent state (thinking, idle, error, done, awaiting approval) with motions and speech bubbles, per-part touch reactions, drag-to-dock, switchable personas, and custom models via URL or local path.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Live2D 桌宠悬浮层：镜像 agent 思考/空闲/出错/完成/待审批状态，配动画与气泡，支持分部位触摸反应、拖动停靠、切换人设，以及通过 URL 或本地路径加载自定义模型。

description.en: Shows a Live2D character in the bottom-right corner of the DSH web UI: blinking, breathing, lip-sync while talking, seven moods, and a speech bubble with its own chat, memory, corpus and stickers. Models are never bundled; every user drops in their own folder.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页右下角放一个 Live2D 角色：会眨眼、会呼吸、说话时嘴动、心情变了眉毛跟着动，用自己的对话气泡聊天，记得住之前说过的，能喂语料，也会配表情包。模型不用内置，谁装谁放自己的文件夹。

description.en: Self-tending living memory in one local SQLite file — a nightly patrol dedupes, merges, decays and cross-links entries on its own, with seven-signal RRF hybrid recall (FTS5 + jieba Chinese-first tokenization, optional vector KNN, graph PPR), a typed knowledge graph, conflict detection instead of silent overwrites, and web telemetry panels.
description.zh: 单文件本地 SQLite 的自整理活记忆——夜巡引擎自动去重、合并、衰减、建链，七信号 RRF 混合检索（FTS5+jieba 中文优先分词、可选向量 KNN、图谱 PPR），带类型知识图谱，冲突检测标记矛盾而非静默覆写，Web 遥测面板。

description.en: Pools several OpenCode Go API keys and hot-switches each request to the least-used one, with official usage and balance lookup plus a graphical settings page.
description.zh: 聚合多个 OpenCode Go API key，把每次请求热切换到用量最低的一个，并提供官方用量/余额查询与设置页图形化管理。

description.en: Fine-grained LLM verification for DSH agents: pairwise rewards over score-token logprobs, Probabilistic Pivot Tournament best-of-N selection, and per-step progress tracking.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 智能体的细粒度 LLM 验证：基于评分 token logprob 期望的成对打分、概率枢纽锦标赛 N 选一与逐步进度追踪。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for querying LLM service provider usage: reads DeepSeek and Moonshot balances plus Kimi For Coding and OpenCode Go quota windows on the host and shows them in an always-visible card with three view modes, edge docking and a collapsed letter bubble.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 服务提供商用量查询插件：在宿主侧读取 DeepSeek、Moonshot 余额与 Kimi For Coding、OpenCode Go 的配额窗口，在常驻卡片中展示，支持三种视图、边缘磁吸与收起为字母气泡。

description.en: Codex App Server model provider using a local Codex login, with session reuse, Harness tool bridging, native action traces, and durable generated-image projection.
description.zh: 使用本地 Codex 登录的 Codex App Server 模型提供方，支持会话复用、Harness 工具桥接、原生动作轨迹和生成图片持久化。

description.en: Automatic provider failover on rate limits or quota exhaustion: switch between providers with configurable per-provider models, a cooldown, and a permanent last-entry fallback.
description.zh: 限流或配额耗尽时自动切换模型提供方：可按提供方配置模型，带冷却机制与永久最终兜底。

description.en: OpenCode Go in the DeepSeek Harness model list, providing subscription quota display, model discovery, session affinity, and more.
description.zh: 把OpenCode Go接入DSH的模型列表，提供订阅额度显示、模型发现、会话亲和等功能。

description.en: LLM adapter plugin for locally deployed Qwen models behind a vLLM OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with per-model multimodal switch, fully configurable reasoning efforts, and a web settings page for editing the deployment from the frontend.
description.zh: 面向 vLLM OpenAI 兼容端点上本地部署的 Qwen 模型的 LLM 适配器插件,支持按模型多模态开关、完全可配置的推理档位,以及可在前端编辑部署配置的 Web 设置页。

description.en: Settings card for the DSH LLM auto-retry engine: tune retry count, backoff and jitter live from Settings -> General, with configurable retryableCodes chips - defaults add INVALID_REQUEST so OpenAI-style HTTP 400 reasoning_text errors in thinking mode get retried automatically.
description.zh: LLM 自动重试设置卡片：在设置页实时调整重试次数、退避与抖动，并可勾选额外可重试错误码（retryableCodes）—— 默认补入 INVALID_REQUEST，OpenAI thinking 模式 HTTP 400 reasoning_text 报错开箱即自动重试。

description.en: Adds Claude, Gemini, and a local Ollama model to DSH's native model picker, using your existing Claude Code / Antigravity CLI logins instead of a metered API key, with a working reasoning-effort selector for Claude.
description.zh: 在 DSH 原生模型选择器里加入 Claude、Gemini 与本地 Ollama 模型，复用你已有的 Claude Code / Antigravity CLI 登录态而不是按量计费的 API Key，并为 Claude 提供可用的推理强度选择。

description.en: Wire-level LLM inspector: captures the raw HTTP request and response bodies of model provider calls and attributes each capture to the session that caused it through the llm/stream waterfall. The request pane renders the body as a collapsible tree with per-node sizes — one measured request was 98.6% a single 973-entry array — and the response pane reassembles the OpenAI-style SSE chunk stream into reasoning, content, tool calls and usage. Shown in a Conversation View tab and a loopback viewer page.
description.zh: 线路层 LLM 检查器：抓取模型调用的原始 HTTP 请求与响应报文，经 llm/stream 瀑布把每次抓取归属到发起它的会话。请求面板把报文渲染成带每节点大小的可折叠树——实测一次请求有 98.6% 是单个 973 项的数组——响应面板则把 OpenAI 风格的 SSE chunk 流重新组装成推理、正文、工具调用与用量。在对话栏标签页与本地查看页展示。

description.en: Native LLM-provider vision bridge: images pasted in the chat are described by a vision model (Qwen3-VL via pi-ai/llama.cpp) and the text description is fed to text-only DeepSeek for the reply — image admission, routing and compaction all run through harness-native mechanisms, with an LRU description cache and 503 retry.
description.zh: DeepSeek 视觉桥接：注册原生 LLM provider，聊天内粘贴的图片自动由视觉模型（pi-ai/llama.cpp 上的 Qwen3-VL）转成文字描述后交给纯文本 DeepSeek 作答——图片准入、路由与会话压缩全部走 harness 原生机制，带 LRU 描述缓存与 503 重试。

description.en: Local plugin installer in the DSH web Settings: a file picker for .tgz plugin packages (multi-select) or a full machine path, installing them into the auto-detected profile via the official `dsh plugin add` with live CLI output — no terminal needed.
description.zh: 本地插件安装器：DSH 网页设置页里的本地插件安装入口——文件选择器多选 .tgz 或输入本机完整路径，自动检测所在 profile 并执行官方 `dsh plugin add`，实时回显安装日志，无需终端。

description.en: Export complete Web Sessions to local Markdown or self-contained HTML, with stable rendered previews, default redaction, and opt-in bounded tool-call details.
description.zh: 把完整 Web Session 导出为本地 Markdown 或自包含 HTML，提供稳定的 Markdown 渲染预览、默认脱敏和可选的有界工具调用详情。

description.en: Adds Korean (한국어) as a native option in Settings - General - Language and translates all 2,775 Web UI strings of dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 and 0.2.1-alpha.2, experimental features included. Works in dsh web and the desktop app.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的「设置 - 通用设置 - 语言」加入韩语（한국어），翻译 dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 与 0.2.1-alpha.2 Web UI 的全部 2,775 条文案，包括实验功能。dsh web 与桌面应用均可使用。

description.en: Adds four extra UI locales to DeepSeek Harness — Traditional Chinese (zh-TW), Japanese, Korean and French. All translation data is bundled, so it works fully offline.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加四种界面语言（繁體中文、日本語、한국어、Français），语料随包内置，完全离线。

description.en: Adds a full-screen dialog for writing long messages: Markdown on the left rendered live by marked on the right, with a draggable splitter that remembers its ratio. Confirming writes the text back to the composer draft, keeping command tokens and @-reference chips as a fixed prefix; Esc asks whether to discard or write back before closing.
description.zh: 为输入框加一个写长内容的全屏弹窗：左侧写 Markdown、右侧 marked 实时渲染，中间分栏可拖动并记住比例。确认后写回输入框草稿，指令 token 与 @ 引用 chip 作为固定前缀保留；Esc 关闭前询问「不写回」还是「写回」。

description.en: Adds a Long text button to the composer tool row: write or paste the body in an editor overlay, and on save it is written to <workspace>/.dsh-longtext/<timestamp>_<title>.md and an @ path reference to that file is appended to the composer, leaving the conversation free of the long text itself.
description.zh: 在输入框工具栏新增「长文本」按钮：在编辑器浮层里写或粘贴正文，保存后写入 <工作区>/.dsh-longtext/<时间戳>_<标题>.md，并把该文件的 @ 路径引用追加到输入框，让正文不进入对话。

description.en: Scene-awareness probe for DSH on macOS: a privacy-first, pull-model `look` tool that reads the frontmost non-self window (app info, AX title/selection, gated local OCR), plus a summon-hotkey snapshot captured the instant you press.
description.zh: macOS 场景感知探针：拉模型零轮询的 look 工具，读取最前非自身窗口（应用信息、AX 标题/选中文本、按需本地 OCR），支持召唤热键按下瞬间抓取快照注入对话。

description.en: Resumes an agent turn that ended after narrating its next action without calling a tool: the guard replays the turn log on agent/turn-stopping, asks a judge model one true/false question, and steers the same turn to run one more step.
description.zh: 续跑「叙述了下一步动作却没调用工具」就结束的 agent 轮次：插件在 agent/turn-stopping 回放该轮日志，让裁判模型回答一次 true/false，命中的话把同一轮再推进一步。

description.en: SillyTavern-style prompt rules for DSH: layered system-prompt anchors, constant/keyword entries, reproducible probability gates and regex rewriting.
description.zh: 类世界书的 DSH 提示词规则：分层系统提示锚点、蓝绿灯条目、可复现概率门与正则替换。

description.en: Local file recall: indexes the folders you choose into one local SQLite database, so 'where did I put that file?' is one query instead of a disk walk. Caches, VCS and program folders are pruned per directory; each folder keeps its own incremental anchor, so a folder added later is backfilled in full. Read-only: it never modifies, moves or deletes your files. Works on DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7 through 0.2.x, tested on 0.2.0-rc.1.
description.zh: 本地文件记忆索引：把指定的文件夹记进本机一个 SQLite 库，忘了东西放哪问一句就能找回，不必翻硬盘；缓存、版本库与程序目录整棵跳过。每个目录各有独立增量锚点，后加入的目录首扫回填全部历史。只读，绝不修改、移动或删除你的文件。 支持 DSH 0.1.7 ~ 0.2.x,已在 0.2.0-rc.1 实测。

description.en: Real-time LSP diagnostics loop: lsp_diagnostics / lsp_workspace_errors / lsp_hover tools over headless stdio language servers (TypeScript/JavaScript + Python), plus an auto-injected post-edit diagnostics delta wired to the harness fs/observed event — Cursor-style edit → diagnostics → fix for dsh agents.
description.zh: 实时 LSP 诊断闭环：通过无头 stdio 语言服务器（TypeScript/JavaScript + Python）提供 lsp_diagnostics / lsp_workspace_errors / lsp_hover 工具，并订阅 harness 的 fs/observed 事件自动注入「本次编辑引入的诊断增量」——为 dsh Agent 带来 Cursor 式的编辑→诊断→修复体验。

description.en: A draggable tarot card back in the corner of the DeepSeek Harness UI. Click to draw, right-click for the four spreads, full 78-card deck with bilingual meanings. Readings use only the cards actually drawn.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 界面角落里可拖动的塔罗牌背。点一下抽牌，右击选四种牌阵，完整 78 张牌库，正逆位含义中英双语。解读只用真正抽到的牌。

description.en: macOS only: holds a PreventUserIdleSystemSleep assertion (caffeinate -i -w <host pid>) while any DSH session runs, and releases it when the last one stops, so a long turn is not cut off by idle sleep. The display may still turn off. It keeps holding through the maintenance phase, where Agent.status reports idle and a long manual /compact runs, via the compaction/start and compaction/end events. It reconciles against ctx.agents.list() every 60s, so a session already running when the plugin is hot-reloaded is picked up at once instead of at the next turn boundary. A failed hold retries with exponential backoff capped at 60s and never gives up; release escalates from SIGTERM to SIGKILL after 2s, and -w lets caffeinate exit by itself if the host dies. No browser half — configured through the profile patch. 51 tests, including two that read pmset -g assertions on real hardware.
description.zh: 仅 macOS：任意 DSH 会话运行期间持有 PreventUserIdleSystemSleep 断言（caffeinate -i -w <宿主 pid>），最后一个会话结束后释放，长时间回合不会因空闲休眠被切断；屏幕仍可正常息屏。它会一直持有跨过 maintenance 阶段——该阶段 Agent.status 报 idle 而手动 /compact 正在跑，靠 compaction/start 与 compaction/end 事件兜住。每 60 秒与 ctx.agents.list() 对账，插件热重载时已在运行的会话立即被接管，不必等到下一个回合边界。持有失败按指数退避重试、上限 60 秒且永不放弃；释放时先 SIGTERM，2 秒未退出升级 SIGKILL；带 -w，宿主崩溃时 caffeinate 自行退出。无前端半身，通过 profile patch 配置。共 51 个测试，其中 2 个在真机上直接读 pmset -g assertions。

description.en: AX-first macOS computer use for DeepSeek Harness: accessibility snapshots with stable refs, background input, Unicode typing, menus and apps, set-of-mark screenshots, on-device OCR and verified actions — 11 tools bridged to the macos-cu CLI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 macOS computer use：基于无障碍树的稳定 ref 定位、后台输入、Unicode 输入、菜单与应用、set-of-mark 截图、本地 OCR 与动作校验——11 个工具桥接 macos-cu CLI。

description.en: macOS desk pet forked from anneheartrecord/dsh-desk-pet, in a real always-on-top window that covers fullscreen Spaces: the pose follows whatever the local DSH is doing across six states, the right-click menu is a real AppKit one carrying quiet mode and a session list, and seven skins ship with it. Two of the seven are drawn from geometry by a script in the repo rather than generated, so making a skin needs no image model and no API credits; the bundled skill still expands one photo into all eighteen poses on your own image tool and credentials. There is no Electron and nothing to install alongside it: the window is driven through ctypes on the Python that ships with macOS.
description.zh: 分叉自 anneheartrecord/dsh-desk-pet 的 macOS 桌宠，一个真的置顶窗口，全屏 Space 也盖得住：姿势跟着本地 DSH 在六种状态之间走，右键菜单是真的 AppKit 菜单，里面有免打扰和会话清单，随包带七套皮肤。七套里有两套是仓库中的脚本用几何画出来的，不是生成的，所以做一套皮肤不需要图像模型、也不烧 API 额度；自带的 skill 仍用你自己的画图工具和额度，把一张照片扩写成十八个姿势。没有 Electron，也不用另装任何东西：窗口是用 macOS 自带的那个 Python 经 ctypes 驱动的。

description.en: macOS Desktop only: one-click restart of the DeepSeek Harness Electron app. Confirms before interrupting running turns, blocks during plugin install/update, and records restart phases/logs.
description.zh: 仅 macOS 桌面版：一键重启 DeepSeek Harness Electron 应用；重启前确认运行中的任务，插件安装/更新时拒绝，并记录重启阶段与日志。

description.en: Restores Cmd+, to open the existing Settings dialog in DeepSeek Harness on macOS.
description.zh: 为 macOS 上的 DeepSeek Harness 恢复 Cmd+, 设置快捷键。

description.en: The complete #dsh-plugin mall inside DeepSeek Harness: browse, search and score the full GitHub dsh-plugin topic catalog refreshed every 2 hours, AI pre-install review with install/caution/avoid verdicts, five-dimension scores with radar charts, nine-language UI, editor picks and personalized recommendations, one-click install/update/rollback with a global task panel, and an in-agent /dsh-mall skill.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 内完整的插件商场：每 2 小时刷新 GitHub #dsh-plugin 全量目录，支持浏览、搜索与评分；AI 装前审查给出装/谨慎/别装结论，五维评分雷达图，九语言界面，编辑精选与个性化推荐，一键安装/更新/回退及全局任务面板，并内置 /dsh-mall skill 在会话中发现插件。

description.en: Map and routing tools: driving/transit/walking/bicycling route planning, geocoding and POI search via free OSM/OSRM data by default, with an optional Amap (高德) key for better China coverage.
description.zh: 地图与路径规划工具：驾车/公交/步行/骑行路线、地理编码与 POI 搜索。默认零 key 使用 OSM/OSRM 免费数据，可选配置高德 key 获得更优的国内覆盖。

description.en: In-chat preview for produced files: click a produced-file chip to render Markdown (server-side markdown-it + highlight.js), images, or plain text right in the conversation; system-app open and reveal-in-folder stay one click away.
description.zh: 产物文件聊天内预览：点击产物 chip 直接在对话中渲染 Markdown（宿主侧 markdown-it + highlight.js 代码高亮）、图片或纯文本，系统应用打开与在文件夹中显示仍一键可达。

description.en: Adds a markitdown tool that converts PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, HTML, CSV, EPUB and URLs to Markdown, using a real Microsoft MarkItDown installation when one is reachable and a bundled dependency-free converter otherwise.
description.zh: 提供 markitdown 工具，把 PDF、Word、Excel、PowerPoint、HTML、CSV、EPUB 与网址转成 Markdown：能找到真实的 Microsoft MarkItDown 时驱动它，否则使用内置的零依赖转换器。

description.en: Review DeepSeek Harness responses with inline annotations, document reading, comment threads, and text revisions, then bring a reading summary back to the main conversation.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的模型回复添加多处批注、文档阅读、评论线程和正文修订，并将阅读摘要带回主对话。

description.en: Builds a Markdown knowledge base from your course materials, then drills you until every knowledge point reaches your target accuracy; each answer must include your reasoning.
description.zh: 从课程材料建一份 Markdown 知识库，然后出题刷到每个知识点都达到目标正确率；每题都必须写出思维链。

description.en: LaTeX snippet expansion in the composer, built from Obsidian LaTeX Suite's own defaults — 138 triggers expand as they are typed, Tab walks the tabstops, and the table of 142 is editable in one JSON file.
description.zh: 输入框里的 LaTeX 片段展开，触发词表直接取自 Obsidian Latex Suite 的默认片段——138 条打完即出，Tab 依次跳 tabstop，142 条全在一份可编辑的 JSON 里。

description.en: DSH Desktop workbench for official MATLAB MCP experiments, verified PNG figures, MATLAB-computed metrics, and PID parameter sweep comparisons. Requires Windows, a MATLAB license and the separately installed official MATLAB MCP Server.
description.zh: 在 DSH Desktop 中通过官方 MATLAB MCP 执行实验，校验 PNG 图像及 MATLAB 计算指标，并比较 PID 参数扫描结果。需要 Windows、MATLAB 授权，以及另行安装的官方 MATLAB MCP Server。

description.en: Execution maze for DSH sessions: the agent's real path — main advance, failed or dead-end detours, backtracks, request retries and subagent branches — drawn on one wall-clock timeline, with three tracks under each lane sharing that axis (tool-call density, token pulse, context pressure) and a deterministic analysis panel below it (tool result matrix, failure-recovery chains, duration distribution); watch it grow live in a session tab, or upload up to 5 session logs for a same-axis compare.
description.zh: 执行迷宫：把智能体真实的执行过程——主干推进、失败或扑空的支路、折返、请求重试与子代理分支——画在同一根墙钟时间轴上；泳道下方是与它共用时间轴的三条数据轨道（工具调用密度、Token 脉冲、上下文压力），再下方是确定性的执行分析面板（工具结果矩阵、失败恢复链、耗时分布）；可在会话页签里实时生长，也可上传最多 5 个 session log 做同轴对比。

description.en: Project-level MCP servers loaded automatically: a project declares them in `.agents/mcp.json` (path and root markers configurable), and every session working inside that project mounts them in its own scope — stdio and Streamable HTTP, tools named `mcp__<server>__<tool>` — with the connections closed when the session ends. A Web UI panel lists the session's servers and their tools, and can enable or disable a project entry after confirmation, backing up and atomically rewriting the manifest.
description.zh: 自动加载项目级 MCP 服务器：项目在 `.agents/mcp.json` 中声明服务器（路径与根目录标记可配置），在项目内工作的每个会话各自的作用域里挂载——支持 stdio 与 Streamable HTTP，工具名为 `mcp__<server>__<tool>`——会话结束时断开连接。Web UI 面板列出本会话的服务器及其工具，并可在确认后启用或禁用项目条目，写入前备份并原子替换清单文件。

description.en: Publishes the running DSH host as a Model Context Protocol endpoint, so other harnesses such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or another DSH can start and continue sessions, read transcripts, wait on or cancel turns, and answer pending approvals; every call is attributed to its caller, and owner-scoped sessions keep callers apart.
description.zh: 把正在运行的 DSH 宿主发布成 MCP 端点，让 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、另一个 DSH 等 harness 可以创建与延续会话、读取对话记录、等待或取消回合、代答待决审批；每次调用都归因到发起方，会话按所有者隔离。

description.en: Context7 MCP bridge: gives the model up-to-date, version-specific library documentation and code examples through the Context7 MCP server, keyless by default.
description.zh: 接入 Context7 托管 MCP 服务，为 agent 提供随版本更新的库文档查询；默认免密钥可用。

description.en: Renders every file mutation in the web chat as one collapsed diff card with per-line highlighting — MCP filesystem edit_file/write_file and the built-in edit/write.
description.zh: 把网页对话里的每次文件改动渲染成一张折叠的 diff 卡片并逐行高亮，涵盖 MCP filesystem 的 edit_file/write_file 与内置的 edit/write。

description.en: Firecrawl MCP bridge: hosted Firecrawl MCP server with keyless search, scrape and parse; an API key unlocks the full tool surface including crawl and map.
description.zh: 接入 Firecrawl 托管 MCP 服务：免密钥即可使用搜索、抓取与解析（有每日额度），配置 API Key 后解锁完整工具集，含爬取与站点地图。

description.en: Progressive-disclosure MCP gateway that searches large remote catalogs through `mcp_search`, then invokes exact schemas through `mcp_call` with lazy connections and bounded caches.
description.zh: 渐进披露 MCP 网关：用 `mcp_search` 检索大型远程工具目录，再由 `mcp_call` 按精确 schema 调用，并采用惰性连接与有界缓存。

description.en: MCP management page in DSH Settings: list, enable/disable, restart and delete MCP servers, edit them in form or JSON mode, expand a server to see the tools it registers, and paste-import MCP configs from 14 tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, VS Code and more) in one go.
description.zh: DSH 设置中的 MCP 管理页：列出、启停、重启、删除 MCP 服务器，表单与 JSON 双模式编辑，展开可查看各服务器注册的工具，并支持一次粘贴导入 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、VS Code 等 14 种工具的 MCP 配置。

description.en: MCP server marketplace for DSH: browse a curated, npm-verified catalog and install MCP servers into the current profile with one click, live without restart.
description.zh: DSH 的 MCP 服务器商场：浏览经过 npm 校验的精选目录，一键安装 MCP 服务器到当前 profile，免重启立即生效。

description.en: MCP manager for DeepSeek Harness Web: a Settings page beside Plugins that lists the MCP servers the running loader tree actually holds, each with its config summary, endpoint and live state, and disables or restores any of them through a paired-marker block in the profile's cordis.patch.yml. Env values, header values and `!!js` sources reach the page only as key names or dot-paths.
description.zh: DSH 的 MCP 极简管理：与「插件」同级的一页设置，列出运行中 Loader 树里真实存在的 MCP 服务器及其配置摘要、端点与实时状态，并通过 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 成对标记块停用或恢复任一服务器；环境变量值、请求头值与 `!!js` 表达式只以键名或点路径的形式到达页面。

description.en: Manage agent skills and MCP servers across DSH, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other tools from one DSH sidebar page: CRUD, cross-tool sharing, import/export, backups and MCP health checks.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏统一管理 DSH、Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等工具的 skill 与 MCP 服务器：增删改查、跨工具共享、导入导出、备份恢复与 MCP 连接体检。

description.en: MCP & Skill manager: enable/disable MCP servers and skills from a Settings panel to free context in real time; optional AI middle layer (mcp_search/mcp_call) calls disabled servers on demand, with state-based visibility filtering that keeps user-enabled servers visible.
description.zh: MCP 与技能管理面板：设置页面板实时启停 MCP 服务器与 Skill 释放上下文占用；可选 AI 中间层（mcp_search/mcp_call）按需调用停用服务器，按 server 状态过滤模型可见性（用户打开的保持可见）。

description.en: Manage MCP servers and skills from a panel in the DSH sidebar: edit rows in the profile or global cordis.patch.yml, toggle them, check whether an HTTP server answers, scan Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / Gemini configs and import the servers they declare, and browse, create, edit, enable or delete skills by rewriting the user-invocable policy in SKILL.md.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏的面板里管理 MCP 服务器与技能：编辑 profile 或全局 cordis.patch.yml 中的行、启用停用、探测 HTTP 服务器是否响应、扫描 Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / Gemini 的配置并导入其中声明的服务器，以及浏览、新建、编辑、启停与删除技能（直接重写 SKILL.md 的 user-invocable 策略位）。

description.en: Tool-surface snapshot and drift gate: baselines the full visible tool registry (name/description/parameters, MCP tools included) into a committable JSON file and warns loudly when an upgrade adds, removes or reshapes a tool.
description.zh: 工具面快照与漂移门：全量可见工具注册表（含 MCP 工具）基线化为可提交的 JSON，升级新增、移除或改动工具时响亮告警。

description.en: MCP server manager for DeepSeek Harness settings: add streamable-http or stdio servers, paste Postman-style headers, test connectivity, and toggle each tool so disabled ones never reach the model.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 MCP 工具管理器：在设置里添加 streamable-http/stdio 服务器、Postman 式请求头、连通性测试，并按工具开关——停用的工具不会进入模型。

description.en: Expose a local MCP server to remote agents through an outbound-only tunnel stack (mcp-proxy + cloudflared Quick Tunnel), then register the public URL into dsh-mcp-client streamable-http config.
description.zh: 把本机 MCP Server 通过出站-only 隧道栈（mcp-proxy + cloudflared Quick Tunnel）暴露给远程 Agent，并把公网 URL 注册进 dsh-mcp-client 的 streamable-http 配置。

description.en: A markdown notes manager for DSH: full **MD notes manager** and **MD notes editor**, quickly capture conversations into notes, maintain notes by **syncing to Git repositories**, and **bring notes into the conversation context**.
description.zh: DSH 的 MD 笔记管理插件：提供完整的 **MD 笔记管理器** 和 **MD 笔记编辑器**，对话内容可快速记入笔记。笔记可 **同步 Git 仓库** 维护。对话时可将笔记 **加入上下文**。

description.en: Native right-sidebar Markdown preview with Mermaid diagrams, KaTeX math, GFM tables and syntax highlighting — rendering engine bundled, fully offline.
description.zh: 在 DSH 原生右侧文件预览中渲染 Mermaid 图表、KaTeX 公式、GFM 表格与代码高亮，渲染引擎随包内置，完全离线。

description.en: A workbench for engineering and math problems, with nine tools for reading images, solving, plotting and verifying answers, plus four bundled skills. Needs Python with numpy and Pillow. Image reading, figure checking and formula typesetting rely on a vision provider you have configured a key for, so those images are sent to it, and without a key they fail while the other tools still work.
description.zh: 工科与数学题解工作台：九个工具覆盖读题、求解、出图与校核，另附四个随包技能。需要带 numpy 与 Pillow 的 Python。读图、图形校核与公式排版依赖你已配置密钥的视觉模型提供商，图片会发给它；未配置密钥时这些功能报失败，其余工具照常可用。

description.en: Show local images and short videos in the DSH conversation card with one-click download of the original file, or offer any other local file for download; works over local and remote connections and keeps the media itself out of the model's vision context.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话卡片内显示本地图片与短视频并提供原文件一键下载，也可为任意其他本地文件提供下载；本机与远程连接均可用，媒体本身不进入模型的视觉上下文。

description.en: Plays video and audio files in the right Sidebar preview pane, streamed over an authenticated HTTP Range route so a remote browser can play and seek a large file without launching a native player on the Host.
description.zh: 在右側欄預覽區直接播放影片同音訊，經帶認證的 HTTP Range 路由串流，令遠端瀏覽器可以播放同跳轉大型檔案，唔使喺主機開原生播放器。

description.en: Clinical documentation and reference bundle for healthcare professionals: SOAP/APSO progress notes, admission H&P, SBAR/I-PASS handover, discharge summaries, Safe Harbor de-identification, patient-instruction readability, completeness checks, and cited lookups against FDA labels, MedlinePlus, PubMed, and ClinicalTrials.gov. Draft-only with a PHI egress guard; not a medical device.
description.zh: 面向临床人员的文档与参考工具包：SOAP/APSO 病程录、入院 H&P、SBAR/I-PASS 交接班、 出院小结、Safe Harbor 脱敏、患者须知可读性评分、完整性检查，以及来自 FDA 说明书、 MedlinePlus、PubMed 和 ClinicalTrials.gov 的带出处检索。仅起草不决定， 内置 PHI 外发守卫；非医疗器械。

description.en: Dual-ledger cross-session memory: auto-extracts lasting facts from conversations into MEMORY.md and maintains a PROGRESS.md project ledger, recalling both into every new session.
description.zh: 双账本跨会话记忆：自动把对话中的长期事实提取进 MEMORY.md，并维护项目进度账本 PROGRESS.md，每个新会话自动召回两本账。

description.en: Local-first long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: text packages, on-demand recall, raw event citation, multiple brains and workspace boundaries.
description.zh: 本地优先的 DSH 长期记忆插件：文本包、按需检索、可回原始事件、多大脑与工作区边界。

description.en: Layered cross-session memory for DSH that pushes only what changed - the first round injects every active entry, later rounds push only added / updated / removed ones, and nothing at all is injected when nothing changed, with keys that merely repeat an entry id left out of the text so the baseline is about 26% smaller. Facts and decisions carry semantic keys (one active truth per key), the model may only write to an inbox that a human promotes, an entry can carry a review date that raises a one-time reminder when due, and search is relevance-ranked with journal lines down-weighted and Chinese matched by bigram. A sidebar tab tells the lifecycle story instead of listing files - entries are grouped by stage (awaiting confirmation / in use / archived) along four axes (topic - one level, human-assigned, type, tag, date), each group can be ticked for batch promote / withdraw / archive / restore / delete / assign topic, and topics can be renamed store-wide or searched on their own. The archived stage reads in three levels - the category says why an entry left (distilled into the docs / useless for good / not needed right now, the first two being defaults you can add to), below it the entry topic stays collapsed until you click it, and entries with no topic sit right under the category. The tab also shows the global and workspace instruction files plus the current injection size. A zero-dependency CLI ships with it, so the store is usable without DSH.
description.zh: 分层跨会话记忆，只推变化的部分：首轮注入全部有效条目，之后只推新增 / 已更新 / 已失效，没有任何变化时一个字都不注入；与条目 id 重复的 key 不再写进正文，基线体积因此小约 26%。事实与决策带语义键（一个 key 只有一个有效结论），模型只能写收件箱、由人确认后才成为常驻事实；条目可以带复核时间，到期后提醒一次；检索按相关度排序、流水行被降权，中文按 bigram 匹配。侧边栏页签不再只是列文件，而是讲清流程：条目按「待你确认 / 已在用 / 已归档」分组，每个阶段都能按四个维度（主题——一级、由人归类，类型，标签，日期）查看；可逐条勾选做批量提升 / 撤回 / 归档 / 取回 / 删除 / 归类，主题可全库改名、也可只在该主题内搜索。「已归档」分三层：分类说明它为什么退场（已蒸馏 / 已废弃 / 暂时不用，前两个是默认分类，也能自己新建一个），分类下面是主题行、点开才列出条目，没写主题的条目直接列在分类下。页签同时显示全局与工作区规范文件以及当前注入体积。附带零依赖 CLI，不装 DSH 也能用这套记忆库。

description.en: A self-contained second brain for DeepSeek Harness — auto-captures durable dialogue knowledge into a local Markdown vault (custom dedup, CJK search, git-friendly), with a graphical knowledge base and an interactive knowledge graph (legend filter, time-dimension coloring, box-select, merge, delete, PNG export/import).
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装上自研「第二大脑」：对话结束自动把值得复用的内容沉淀成本地 Markdown 知识卡（自研去重、CJK 检索、可 git 管理），设置页提供图形化知识库 + 交互式知识图谱（图例过滤、时间维、框选、合并、导入导出）。

description.en: Layered long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: a ~600-character hot layer that evicts its own overflow, month-archived cold entries recalled by keyword and ranked by usage, and extractive day/week/month summaries.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的分层长期记忆：热层约 600 字、超限自动腾挪，冷层按月归档、可按关键词跨月召回并按使用度排序，日/周/月三级抽取式摘要控制注入体量。

description.en: Cross-session long-term memory: captures durable facts from each turn, auto-associates them by shared entity and tag, and recalls with BM25 plus spreading activation over the link graph.
description.zh: 跨会话长期记忆：从每轮对话抽取持久事实、按共享标签与实体自动建立联想关联，并以 BM25 加关联图激活传播进行召回；提供六个模型可调用工具与一张设置卡片。

description.en: Distills long sessions into background observations and reflections, injects them as a system-prompt section, and renders compaction summaries from prepared memory; includes a Settings page and source-backed recall.
description.zh: 在后台把长会话提炼为观察与反思并注入系统提示，压缩时直接用预备记忆渲染摘要；提供设置页与可回溯原文的 memory_recall。

description.en: Brings your existing Claude / ChatGPT history into DSH: instant zero-token import of the memories.json inside a Claude export, local Claude Code transcripts with no export needed, and conversations distilled through the model you already configured in DSH. Every memory carries verbatim evidence checked against the source by code — a paraphrase is dropped and counted, and evidence found only in the assistant turns is always routed to review rather than stored.
description.zh: 把你在 Claude / ChatGPT 里已有的历史搬进 DSH：Claude 导出包里的 memories.json 零 token 瞬时入库，本机 Claude Code 记录免导出直读，历史对话用你在 DSH 里已配好的模型提纯。每条记忆都带由代码回原文核对的逐字证据——转述会被丢弃并计数，只在 AI 回复里找到的证据一律转人工确认而非直接入库。

description.en: Injects your existing markdown documents (notes, rules, knowledge-base files) into every dsh session's system prompt as read-only memory — list file or directory paths in `files`; no database, no service, no write path; UTF-8 byte-budgeted truncation with line-boundary fallback, total budget, YAML front-matter stripping, and freshness timestamps.
description.zh: 把本地已有的 markdown 文档（笔记、规则、知识库）按路径清单注入 dsh 每个会话的系统提示词，当只读记忆——无数据库、无服务、无写入通道；支持目录收集、UTF-8 字节预算截断、front-matter 剥离与新鲜度时间戳。

description.en: Human-governed cross-session memory spaces with independent source and consumer relationships, provenance, versioning, and pre-send injection review.
description.zh: 用户治理的跨会话记忆空间，提供独立的来源与使用关系、来源追踪、版本管理和发送前注入检查。

description.en: Memory triage for DeepSeek Harness: at the end of each turn it decides which entries to keep and which to archive, routes project-specific ones into a project bucket while global ones stay in the main store, merges near-duplicate entries, and falls back to an LLM when the rules are unsure — automatic actions are recoverable archives only, never deletions.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 记忆分诊插件：每轮对话结束自动判断条目保留或归档，把项目条目迁入 project 桶、全局条目留在总体记忆，合并近义重复条目，规则拿不准时用 LLM 兜底；自动动作只做可恢复的归档，永不直接删除。

description.en: Send "Memory unlocked" to let the AI recall conversations it has forgotten.
description.zh: 发送“大记忆恢复术”来让 AI 回想起忘记的对话。

description.en: Cross-session memory vault: remember / recall / forget tools, per-turn prompt injection, and a settings-page entry browser.
description.zh: 跨会话记忆库：remember / recall / forget 工具、每轮提示注入与设置页条目浏览。

description.en: Windows commit-charge watchdog for DSH Desktop: samples committed memory every 5 seconds, attributes it to the DSH process tree and the largest consumers, blocks automatic restart when DSH is not the main committer, and adds read-only pagefile advice, a 7-day crash timeline and an event export; automatic restart and crash resume are both off by default.
description.zh: DSH Desktop 的 Windows 提交内存看门狗：每 5 秒采样提交内存，把它归因到 DSH 进程树与占用最高的进程，在 DSH 不是主要占用者时阻止自动重启，并给出只读的分页文件建议、7 天崩溃时间线与事件导出；自动重启与崩溃后自动续接默认都是关闭的。

description.en: Bridges DSH to a local MemVault store: core memory blocks injected into the system prompt, finished turns extracted through MemVault's own pipeline, and a panel to browse, trace, review and replay what was stored.
description.zh: 把 DSH 接到本机 MemVault 记忆库：核心记忆块注入系统提示词、结束的轮次经由 MemVault 自己的管线抽取，并提供浏览、追溯、复核与重抽的面板。

description.en: Adds a custom right-click context menu to the sidebar workspace files tree, with new folder, rename, reveal in file manager, open in browser, open in VS Code, copy path, streaming ZIP download, and delete.
description.zh: 为侧边栏「工作区文件」树添加自定义右键菜单：新建文件夹、重命名、在文件管理器中显示、浏览器打开、VS Code 打开、复制路径、流式 ZIP 下载、删除。

description.en: Plays Inception Mercury's diffusion (denoising) stream live in the dsh Web UI answer bubble: for routes that support it, the request is re-sent with `diffusing: true` and the real frames are replayed from noise to final text, while only the converged answer reaches the session log. Support is detected per provider/model with a probe that is rejected before any token is generated, a floating per-model toggle turns it on, and attachments, auxiliary calls or unsupported routes fall back to the original adapter. Replaces the assistant-message renderer for all models while enabled.
description.zh: 在 dsh Web UI 的回答气泡里实时播放 Inception Mercury 的扩散（去噪）过程：对支持的路由以 `diffusing: true` 重发请求，按真实帧从噪声播放到最终文本，会话日志只写入收敛后的答案。按 provider/model 用一个在生成前就被拒绝的探测请求判断是否支持，右侧浮动按钮按模型开关；带附件、辅助调用或不支持的路由一律回退原适配器。启用期间会接管所有模型的助手消息渲染。

description.en: Makes the AI default to Mermaid diagrams in development conversations — system prompt guidance, a mermaid_validate syntax-check tool with real-parser validation, and an output gate that auto-fixes or removes broken diagrams. Rendering via dsh-mermaid.
description.zh: 让 AI 在开发交流中默认用 Mermaid 图表达——系统提示引导、mermaid_validate 真解析语法校验工具，以及自动修复或摘除坏图的输出闸。渲染交给 dsh-mermaid。

description.en: Renders the open conversation's Mermaid diagrams as a right-sidebar page, one card per diagram, each clickable to open full screen with zoom and pan; the chat's own code block is left untouched, so copying or quoting the source still works.
description.zh: 把当前对话里的 Mermaid 图表渲染成右侧栏的一个页面，一图一卡片；点击卡片可全屏查看并缩放、拖动，对话里的原始代码块保持不动，因此复制或引用源码照常可用。

description.en: Copy selections from assistant messages as Markdown, preserving links, LaTeX sources, and code-fence language info.
description.zh: 将助手消息中选中的内容复制为 Markdown，保留链接、LaTeX 源码与代码块语言信息。

description.en: Branch-based message editing, reroll, retry, and a version timeline.
description.zh: 基于分支的消息编辑、reroll、重试与版本时间线。

description.en: Multi-platform message gateway and WeCom AI bot bridge with session context compression and smartsheet creation.
description.zh: 多平台消息网关与企微智能机器人桥接：会话自动压缩持久化与智能表格一键创建。

description.en: Adds a Codex-style message navigation rail for quickly locating earlier prompts in long DeepSeek Harness Web UI conversations.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 添加 Codex 风格的消息导航轨道，方便在长会话中快速定位历史提问。

description.en: Current-session message outline rail for the DSH web UI — your messages show as slim bars on the left edge; hover to expand the full outline (line number + text), click to jump instantly to that message. Pure frontend, zero external service dependencies, sessions-snapshot driven with zero polling.
description.zh: 当前会话消息大纲（左缘横杠）——你的消息在对话区左缘显示一列细横杠，hover 展开完整大纲（行号+文本），点击瞬间定位到对话里那条消息。纯前端、零外部服务依赖、sessions 快照驱动零轮询。

description.en: Codex-style left-side message navigation rail for the Web UI: one tick per user message, hover previews, and click-to-jump across the whole history.
description.zh: Codex 风格左侧消息导航轨道：每条用户消息一个刻度，悬停预览、点击跳转，全历史一次索引。

description.en: Auto-repairs the messages array after a tool-dispatch crash (orphaned tool_calls / tool messages), preventing 400 INVALID_REQUEST session lock-ups.
description.zh: 工具调度崩溃后自动修复 messages 数组（孤儿 tool_calls / tool 消息），防止 400 INVALID_REQUEST 会话卡死。

description.en: Connects a DSH Host to Slack and Feishu using your own bot applications.
description.zh: 使用自建机器人应用，将一个 DSH Host 接入 Slack 和飞书。

description.en: Milestone progress soft-enforcement guard: injects persistent system-prompt rules and post-execute notices when tool calls omit visible progress text, with a Web settings form.
description.zh: 阶段性结论软强制守卫：常驻注入系统提示词规范，并在模型调用工具漏发可见结论时自动附加软强制纠偏提醒，支持 Web 设置表单。

description.en: Model usage panel for DeepSeek Harness: automatic per-call accounting from session logs with real timestamps, full history and live increments, showing tokens, cost, requests, trend and model composition with per-model, per-project and per-session views and editable tiered pricing.
description.zh: MIMO Quota Panel —— DeepSeek Harness 的模型额度面板。装上即用，零配置：从会话事件日志逐调用自动记账（真实时间戳、全历史、实时增量），一屏展示 Token 用量、消费金额、请求次数、趋势波形、模型构成，支持按模型 / 粒度 / 时间范围 / 项目·对话 统计切换。内置可编辑定价，DeepSeek 峰谷价按记录时间自动套算，小米全系牌价开箱即用。

description.en: Registers the minas-webdav MCP server as one stdio row, giving the agent 14 tools for a Xiaomi Smart Storage (MINAS) NAS without mounting it: list, stat, tree, find, du, df, cat, upload, download, mkdir, move, copy, delete and a capability probe. The Python package behind it is installed separately with pipx.
description.zh: 把 minas-webdav MCP server 注册成一行 stdio 配置，给 agent 14 个工具，不挂盘直接操作小米智能存储（MINAS）：列目录、stat、tree、find、du、df、cat、上传下载、mkdir、移动复制删除，另带能力探测。Python 包需另行 pipx 安装。

description.en: Live, bidirectional mind map for DSH Web built on Mind Elixir: the agent and the user edit the same tree in real time in a docked panel or fullscreen, with PNG export and open-in-desktop.
description.zh: DSH Web 实时双向思维导图：Agent 与用户共编同一棵树，改动即时互相同步，支持停靠分屏与全屏两种视图。

description.en: Plug-in vision for text-only models on DSH, with native interaction for image understanding and generation, GUI automation, through layered evidence memory and cache.
description.zh: 为 DSH 上的纯文本模型提供视觉插件：通过分层证据记忆与缓存，实现图片理解与生成的原生交互及 GUI 自动化。

description.en: Presents DSH Web as a playable, full-screen first-person Minecraft-style voxel interface—not a color-only skin: users walk through a persistent Three.js block world and access native workspaces, sessions, conversations, tools, model selection, permissions, context information, and the composer through in-world facilities and a workbench.
description.zh: 将 DSH Web 直接呈现为可游玩的全屏第一人称 Minecraft 风格体素界面，而非只更换颜色的皮肤：用户可以在可持久化的 Three.js 方块世界中移动，并通过游戏内设施和工作台使用原生工作区、会话、对话、工具、模型选择、权限、上下文信息与输入框。

description.en: Parse PDFs and documents into structured Markdown with MinerU. Uploads files to the MinerU cloud; no offline mode.
description.zh: 用 MinerU 把 PDF 与文档解析为结构化 Markdown。文件会上传到 MinerU 云端，无离线模式。

description.en: Minimal-compatible first turn for Web root sessions: starts with persistent bash and str_replace_editor, removes automatic workspace and skill context, then restores the selected preset after the first tool call or reply; includes a persistent composer toggle.
description.zh: Web 根会话的首轮精简：先使用持久 bash 与 str_replace_editor，移除自动工作区和技能上下文；首次工具调用或回复后恢复所选预设，带持久 composer 开关。

description.en: Permanently deletes a session from the sidebar, waiting for a running turn to stop and cascading to its subagent sessions.
description.zh: 从侧边栏永久删除会话：等待正在运行的回合停下，并级联删除其子代理会话。

description.en: Shows MiniMax Token Plan usage beside the DSH Web UI model selector with compact 5h/7d bars, click-to-refresh, automatic idle and heartbeat refreshes, and endpoint fallback. Reuses subscription keys configured under Settings → Model and appears only for MiniMax Token Plan providers.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 模型选择器旁显示 MiniMax Token Plan 用量，以紧凑的 5h/7d 进度条展示，支持点击刷新、空闲与心跳自动刷新及接口回退；复用「设置 → 模型」中的订阅 Key，且仅在 MiniMax Token Plan provider 下显示。

description.en: DSH secretary: triages your unread GitHub notifications by their real state every 15 minutes (closing what is already resolved), remembers dated things you tell it (bills, renewals, document expiries, birthdays) and reminds you when due, and watches your inbox read-only; secrets live in the system keychain only.
description.zh: DSH 小秘书：每 15 分钟按当前状态分诊 GitHub 未读通知（已解决的替你关掉），记住你交代的到期事项（账单、续费、证件、生日）到时提醒，只读盯着邮箱收件箱；密码只进系统钥匙串。

description.en: Low-contrast graphite dark theme with a frosted-glass sidebar, composer and panels for the DSH Web GUI.
description.zh: 低对比度石墨灰深色主题，侧边栏、输入区与弹层使用可调强度的毛玻璃。

description.en: MiniMax multimodal bridge: one `mmx_bridge` tool covers image understanding/generation, video, TTS, music, cover, web search and quota; optional `web_search`/`read_image` takeover; inline players/image previews right in the Web GUI (npm: `dsh-mmx-bridge`).
description.zh: MiniMax 多模态桥接：一个 `mmx_bridge` 工具覆盖图片理解/生成、视频、语音合成、音乐、翻唱、联网搜索与用量查询；可选接管 `web_search`/`read_image`；对话流直接内嵌播放器与图片预览（npm: `dsh-mmx-bridge`）。

description.en: Below 1024px the sidebar collapses to a 44px floating square and expands into a 280px overlay drawer; picking a session collapses it again and the focus grab that would raise the soft keyboard after a session switch is suppressed.
description.zh: 窄屏下侧栏收起为左上角 44 像素悬浮方块、展开为 280 像素覆盖式抽屉，点会话自动收起，并压掉切会话时自动抢焦点导致的软键盘顶起。

description.en: Mobile UI shell for the DSH Web GUI: turns the desktop three-column layout into a touch-friendly phone layout (overlay drawers, draggable FAB, full-screen dialogs, infinite-scroll history) under a 1024px viewport, with zero desktop impact. - Complete mobile PWA for DSH, built on dsh-mobile-gate: secure remote-access gateway plus install-to-homescreen (manifest + service worker), offline capability, touch gestures (pull-to-refresh, edge-swipe back, pinch-zoom font), agent-done push notifications, and touch-first layout — desktop unaffected.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的移动端适配：窄屏下把桌面三栏布局改造成触屏友好的手机布局（覆盖式抽屉、可拖拽悬浮按钮、全屏弹窗、上滑加载历史），1024px 断点内生效，桌面端零影响。 — 基于 dsh-mobile-gate 的完整移动端 PWA：安全远程访问网关 + 可安装到主屏（manifest + service worker）+ 离线可用 + 触屏手势（下拉刷新/边缘返弹/捏合缩放字体）+ agent 完成推送 + 触屏优先布局，桌面零影响。

description.en: Complete mobile PWA for DSH, built on dsh-mobile-gate: secure remote-access gateway plus install-to-homescreen (manifest + service worker), offline capability, touch gestures (pull-to-refresh, edge-swipe back, pinch-zoom font), agent-done push notifications, and touch-first layout — desktop unaffected.
description.zh: 基于 dsh-mobile-gate 的完整移动端 PWA：安全远程访问网关 + 可安装到主屏（manifest + service worker）+ 离线可用 + 触屏手势（下拉刷新/边缘返弹/捏合缩放字体）+ agent 完成推送 + 触屏优先布局，桌面零影响。

description.en: Drive your dsh agent from WeChat over the iLink gateway: two-way encrypted media transfer (auto-decrypt inbox + /send), proactive weixin_send tool, completion notifications, multi-session switching, and a health panel with file logging.
description.zh: 微信遥控 DeepSeek Harness：iLink 双向加密文件收发（入站自动解密落盘 + /send 出站）、weixin_send 主动通知、完成通知、多会话切换、健康面板与文件日志。

description.en: Below 1024px the sidebar leaves the shell frame entirely and is opened as an overlay drawer from a header button, so the conversation gets the full viewport width; wider layouts are untouched.
description.zh: 視窗闊度細過 1024px 時，側欄完全移出 shell frame，改由頁首按鈕以浮動抽屜方式打開，令對話可以用盡整個螢幕闊度；闊螢幕版面唔受影響。

description.en: Mobile-viewport fixes for the dsh web GUI: overlay drawer sidebar with swipe gestures, icon-only composer with a mode · model · effort status line, centered popovers, and horizontal-overflow/scrollbar centering fixes.
description.zh: 修复 dsh web GUI 的手机视口体验：抽屉式侧栏与滑动手势、纯图标 composer 与「权限·模型·思考深度」状态行、浮窗居中、横向溢出与滚动条挤压居中修复。

description.en: Provider-folded model selector for the DSH Web composer with catalog-driven reasoning effort choices.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 输入栏提供按 provider 折叠的模型选择器，并使用模型目录中的真实推理档位。

description.en: Adds an input-modality selector to custom model settings in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的自定义模型设置添加输入模态选择器。

description.en: Adds a model route where a Lead plans and reviews while a Sidekick performs code changes.
description.zh: 提供由 Lead 规划与审查、Sidekick 执行代码修改的组合模型线路。

description.en: Single-model disable gate: hides denied models from DSH catalogs, blocks direct dispatch with an in-protocol error chunk, and exposes a settings UI for the denylist.
description.zh: 提供模型粒度的启用禁用机制：从 DSH 模型目录隐藏被禁用的模型，以协议内错误块拦截直接分发请求，并提供UI设置界面。

description.en: Model Health panel in Settings: lists every model configured in settings.yaml and batch-tests availability and latency for each.
description.zh: 设置页「模型健康」面板：列出 settings.yaml 配置的全部模型，一键批量测试可用性与延迟。

description.en: Manual model probe for DeepSeek Harness: a session-view tab where you pick provider, API type, model and route, then send one real raw HTTP request over openai-completions, openai-responses or anthropic-messages — streaming or not — and read latency, TTFT, HTTP status, token usage and a three-layer diagnosis chain (API request / model response / strict check) on one screen, with errors in plain language.
description.zh: DSH 模型健康检查：会话视图页签内按「供应商 → API 类型 → 模型 → 路由」选定目标，手动发一条真实裸 HTTP 请求（支持 openai-completions / openai-responses / anthropic-messages 三协议，流式可切），一屏看清耗时、TTFT、HTTP 状态、token 用量与三层诊断链（API 请求 / 模型响应 / 严格校验），错误全部人话化。

description.en: Only the domains you list go through a proxy: add a model host that needs the proxy to be reachable, and web search plus every other request stays on the normal network. Multiple named proxies can serve different domains, with a never-proxy list on top; saved settings apply on the next request without a restart.
description.zh: 某个模型的 API 要代理才连得上？把它的域名填进来就行——只有你列出的域名走代理，网页搜索等其它请求照旧直连，互不打扰。可以配多个代理分给不同域名，也能指定某些域名永远不走代理；保存后下一次请求就生效，不用重启。

description.en: Keeps the shared default model pinned, so switching the model inside a chat no longer rewrites the global default and no longer lowers that default's reasoning effort.
description.zh: 锁定共享的默认模型：在聊天里切换模型不再改写全局默认值，也不会再被那次切换连带降档推理强度。

description.en: Reasoning-effort tier manager for custom API models plus cross-session preference memory: inline low/medium/high/max toggles inside Settings → Models, with atomic settings writes.
description.zh: 为自定义 API 模型提供推理强度分级管理与跨会话偏好记忆：在「设置 → 模型」中内联切换 low/medium/high/max，配置写入为原子操作。

description.en: Provider-tabbed model picker for the dsh web composer: left provider column and right model list, both independently scrollable, with cross-provider search.
description.zh: dsh web 输入栏模型选择面板：左侧提供商栏 + 右侧模型列表，两侧独立滚动，支持跨提供商搜索。

description.en: Model pricing for the DSH settings page: ~7,250 models / 213 providers with the harness catalog overlaid, honest lowest-listed comparison, session costs priced by the actual route, cache-leak attribution, and a verified promotion feed.
description.zh: DSH 设置页中的模型价格表：约 7,250 个模型 / 213 个提供商（叠加本地路由目录），诚实的最低标价比较、按实际路由计价的会话成本、缓存泄漏归因，以及经验证的促销信息源。

description.en: Lifecycle management UI for the llm-pi-ai model provider: create, edit, delete, enable and disable providers with custom headers and AES-GCM-encrypted API keys; uninstall-safe restore of parked providers, remote model discovery with batch write, smart routing with five strategies, union/intersection composites, per-model connectivity tests, and request observability.
description.zh: llm-pi-ai 模型提供商的生命周期管理 UI：提供商的新建/编辑/删除与启停（自定义请求头、AES-GCM 加密密钥）；卸载时安全还原滞留提供商，远端模型发现与批量写入，五种策略的智能路由，并集/交集组合提供商，逐模型连通性测试与请求观测。

description.en: Measures what an llm-pi-ai endpoint really accepts — context window from its own model list, output-token limit and reasoning levels read out of its own range errors, image support from a generated test image — then reports declared values that contradict that evidence and rewrites them only after confirmation.
description.zh: 直接实测 llm-pi-ai 端点真正接受的能力——从它自己的模型列表取上下文窗口，从它自己的报错反推输出上限与推理档位，用生成的测试图验证图像支持——再报告与证据不符的声明值，确认后才改写。

description.en: Ranks the models a DeepSeek Harness install already discovered by measured connectivity and speed, and switches to the next candidate inside the same turn when the one in use fails without producing any output. Ships a settings page with a grouped model list, per-model and per-channel switches, and a quota-aware cooldown that rests an exhausted model until the next day.
description.zh: 把本机已发现的 DSH 模型按实测连通性与速度排序，当前模型无输出失败时在同一回合内切到下一个候选。附带设置页：按渠道分组的模型列表、逐模型与逐渠道开关，以及额度耗尽后休息到次日的冷却策略。

description.en: English-only fork of dsh-model-router. Routes each agent step across a configurable model pool and adjusts reasoning effort based on task complexity, tool failures, and cost.
description.zh: dsh-model-router 的纯英文分支。把每个 agent 步骤路由到可配置的模型池，并按任务复杂度、工具失败与成本调整推理强度。

description.en: Writes live provider model lists into DSH settings and shows 5h/7d plan windows or metered balance for the current session model.
description.zh: 把各提供方线上模型列表写进 DSH 设置，输入框圆环显示当前会话模型的 5 小时/7 天窗口或按量剩余余额。

description.en: Model visibility manager for DeepSeek Harness: hide or show any model in the conversation model selector from a dedicated settings page. Per-model switches, search, provider-level batch actions, reset-all. Zero intrusion - writes only its own hidden list, never the provider config; hiding a model in use never interrupts a running session.
description.zh: DSH 模型可见性管理：在独立的设置分区页里按渠道/模型隐藏或显示模型选择菜单中的条目。逐模型开关、实时搜索、渠道级批量隐藏/显示、一键恢复全部。零侵入——只写插件自己的隐藏列表，不改 Provider 配置，隐藏正在使用的模型不会中断会话。

description.en: Fills in the vision capability that DSH's "fetch models" step drops, so image-capable models stop being declared text-only, and marks them in the model name.
description.zh: 补上 DSH「获取可用模型」漏记的视觉能力，让能看图的模型不再被当成纯文本，并在模型名后标出「可看图」。

description.en: Modellix integration for DSH: schema-driven image, video and audio generation in a split Design workspace, a live LLM model catalog, and native web search and fetch providers through one API key.
description.zh: 将 Modellix 接入 DSH：使用一个 API Key 在分栏 Design 工作区中提供基于 Schema 的图片、视频与音频生成、实时 LLM 模型目录，以及原生网页搜索与抓取 Provider。

description.en: Displays CodexRadar model capability benchmarks in a Settings page and shows the selected session model's DeepSWE score beside the composer.
description.zh: 在设置页展示 CodexRadar 模型能力评测，并在输入框旁显示当前会话所选模型的 DeepSWE 分数。

description.en: Model attribution panel for the dsh web chat — local, zero-network structural fingerprinting (template token leaks, glitch canaries, tokenizer usage-vector matching) that scores which of 29 AI vendors a session's responses most resemble, with a per-claim evidence ledger and a 12-probe active battery.
description.zh: 在 dsh 网页端挂载模型归属面板，用纯本地、零联网的结构指纹匹配（模板特殊 token 泄漏、glitch 金丝雀、tokenizer usage 向量比对）判断当前会话的回答最像 29 家 AI 厂商中的哪一家，每个结论附带可展开的证据账本，另附 12 探针主动取证电池。

description.en: PCL-style modpack for DSH plugins: export a small .dshpack.zip manifest of the selected third-party plugins and their versions, then import it with a preview before reinstalling.
description.zh: PCL 式 DSH 整合包：勾选已安装插件导出小体积 .dshpack.zip 与安装命令串，导入时先预览、确认后再按版本重新安装。

description.en: Gives DSH the full 33-tool browser surface (ctx.browser seam -> a self-hosted headless moli browser over CDP: one 127.0.0.1 daemon with Bearer-token auth, request-path whitelist and WebSocket rewriting, no root/GUI/Electron needed; single-engine moli serve with auto LD_LIBRARY_PATH/FONTCONFIG_FILE injection and a persistent profile dir for logins), plus a web panel — a real page you can click, scroll and type in, operation/console/network logs with one-click cleanup, a customizable window (border color, transparency, glass, fit-to-picture with no black bars, top-inset and self-centering) and an adjustable page size (1920x1080 by default) — plus a collapsed pill that can be dragged to any spot on the screen (free position), a live view that auto-resumes when you switch back to the web tab, and a 1920px default max edge for the live frame — and two bundled skills (browser, browser-runtime) served through the plugin built-in skill provider, so the skill centre lists them as system-level by default without writing into $DSH_HOME/skills.
description.zh: 为 DSH 挂出完整的浏览器工具面（33 个 browser_* 工具）：把 ctx.browser 接缝接到自管的 moli 无头浏览器（经 127.0.0.1 单例 CDP 守护进程，带 Bearer token 鉴权、请求路径白名单与 WebSocket 地址改写，不需要 root / GUI 库 / Electron；单发动机 moli serve 直连，自动注入 LD_LIBRARY_PATH 与 FONTCONFIG_FILE，profile 目录持久化登录态）；另带一个网页面板——可直接点、滚、打字的实时页面，操作/控制台/网络日志与一键清理，窗口外观（边框色、透明度、玻璃效果）与几何（贴合画面比例去黑边、顶部留白、默认居中）可自定义，页面分辨率可调（默认 1920×1080）——收起后的胶囊可拖到任意位置（自由位置），切回「网页」自动续帧不用再点「开始」，实时画面「最大边」默认 1920——外加两份随包技能（browser、browser-runtime），由插件经 DSH 内置技能提供者提供，技能中心显示「系统内置」，默认不往 $DSH_HOME/skills 落盘。

description.en: Persistent background watchers that wake the agent on new messages (file inbox or command-output delta) — the harness analog of Claude Code's Monitor tool.
description.zh: 常驻后台监视器：文件收件箱（NDJSON）或命令输出增量一到就唤醒 agent，相当于 Claude Code Monitor 工具的 Harness 实现。

description.en: Per-model reasoning effort (off/minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh) for GPT, Codex, Gemini and OpenAI-compatible models. Installs a helper, not a runtime adapter: run enable-capabilities.ps1 once per profile (Windows) and restart — it declares the levels in ~/.dsh/settings.yaml, with a disable script and a backup to revert.
description.zh: 为 GPT、Codex、Gemini 与 OpenAI-compatible 模型提供按模型的推理等级（off/minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh）。装的是 helper 而不是运行时适配器：需按 profile 手动跑一次 enable-capabilities.ps1（Windows）并重启——它把等级声明写进 ~/.dsh/settings.yaml，附带还原脚本与备份。

description.en: A newspaper-style front page for a session you left running, as a Conversation View tab beside Chat and Trajectory: a per-turn timeline (duration, steps, tools, tokens, outcome), file churn counted per file, where the wall clock went and how much of it was the model rather than tools, which single turn ate the spend, failures nobody retried quoted with their failing command, and a context-pressure gauge measured against the routed model's own declared capacity. The briefing is folded from the durable session log and never generated by a model, so it costs no tokens, cannot hallucinate, and is byte-identical for the same log and clock; it appends nothing to the session and reaches no model, and it reports a pending approval without ever answering it. Pages are offered only when they have content, and the tab refreshes itself on turn settle and on a two-speed poll backed by a metadata-only tail probe.
description.zh: 把跑着的会话排成一张报纸式头版，作为 Chat 与 Trajectory 旁的 Conversation View 标签页：逐轮时间线（耗时、步数、工具、token、结果）、按文件统计的改动热度、墙钟时间去向以及其中多少是模型而非工具、哪一轮吃掉了花费、无人重试的失败（附失败命令），以及对照该路由模型自报容量的上下文压力仪表。简报由持久会话日志折算而成、从不调用模型：零 token、不会编造、同一份日志与时钟下字节一致；不向会话追加任何内容、也不触达模型，只报告待批准项而绝不代为应答。仅在某一页有内容时才提供该页；标签页在轮次结束时自刷新，并用只读日志尾部的探针做两档轮询。

description.en: Imports Claude Code setup into DeepSeek Harness from a native settings screen or CLI, with dry-run previews for skills, commands, agents, hooks, permission rules, and MCP config. Codex and OpenCode remain supported as secondary origins, with collision-safe apply and post-move checks.
description.zh: 通过原生设置页或 CLI 将 Claude Code 配置迁入 DeepSeek Harness，可先预览技能、命令、代理、hooks、权限规则与 MCP 配置；Codex 和 OpenCode 作为次要来源继续支持，并提供目标冲突保护和迁移后检查。

description.en: Fine grained per tool permission rules for DSH at the tools/pre-execute gate, deny and ask lists in Claude Code rule syntax (`Bash(rm -rf:*), Read(_secrets_), mcp__server__tool`), works standalone without migrating.
description.zh: 为 DSH 补上按工具粒度的权限规则：在 tools/pre-execute 强制执行 deny/ask 清单，规则语法与 Claude Code 相同，不迁移也能单独用。

description.en: IM channel bridge: WeChat (ilinkai) / QQ / Feishu with proactive push — wake the channel bot from scheduled tasks and deliver AI replies to your phone.
description.zh: IM 渠道桥：微信（ilinkai）/ QQ / 飞书接入，支持主动推送——定时任务可唤醒渠道 bot 并把 AI 回复推送到手机。

description.en: Multi-candidate mode for DeepSeek Harness (test-time scaling): floating panel config, the agent auto-runs parallel candidates plus verifier selection, scoped to the current session.
description.zh: 多候选模式插件（test-time scaling）：悬浮球面板配置，模型对任务自动执行并行候选加验证选优，仅当前会话生效。

description.en: Multi-window wall for the DSH Web UI: run and monitor N conversations side-by-side in one screen, with auto-discovery, per-window controls, and an authenticated LAN gateway for phone/tablet access.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面里并排运行、监控多个对话实例：多窗口墙 + 自动发现 + 单窗控制，内置带口令认证的局域网网关，手机/平板也能看。

description.en: Multi-model orchestrator: the main brain decomposes complex tasks and dispatches subtasks to GLM / Kimi / Qwen sub-agents by each model's strengths, with per-model token usage.
description.zh: 多模型主脑编排器：主模型将复杂任务拆解，按各模型优劣分派给 GLM / Kimi / Qwen 子代理执行，并按模型统计 token 用量。

description.en: Multi-role parallel argumentation for DeepSeek Harness: runs the real Codex and Claude CLIs in parallel, has the DSH model (Judge) write a third-party verdict back into the conversation, plus Obsidian-style single-agent direct chat and per-role model config.
description.zh: 多角色并行论证：并行调用真实 Codex 与 Claude，由 DSH 主会话模型（Judge）生成第三方汇总并回对话；另含单 Agent 直接对话与各角色模型自由配置。

description.en: Replaces the sidebar workspace region with a two-tab browser: several workspace roots stay registered side by side while conversations are filed under the real working directory of each session, with a read-only resource tree that previews files in the right sidebar. Hiding is per tab, display-only and fully reversible; a resource folder or file can be copied as a path or dragged into the composer as a native reference, and @ completion covers every registered root rather than the working directory alone.
description.zh: 把侧边栏的工作区区域换成双选项卡浏览器：多个工作区根并列登记、各自固定不变，对话按每个会话真实的工作目录归入目录树，资源是只读文件树、点击即用右侧栏预览。两个选项卡各自独立隐藏、只影响显示且完全可逆；资源文件夹或文件可复制路径，也可拖进输入框成为原生引用块；@ 补全覆盖全部已登记工作区，而不只是当前工作目录。

description.en: Single/multi-line composer toggle for the DSH Web GUI: an editable shortcut (registered through the harness shortcut service) — Cmd/Ctrl+E on desktop builds and Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+E in the browser, with Linux browsers unbound until you pick one — switches the composer between its native single-line shape and a four-line-plus draft area; a small tab on the composer shoulder always shows the current shortcut and target mode; while multi-line, Enter inserts a newline and Shift+Enter sends, and the mode is remembered per device.
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框单行/多行切换：通过官方快捷键服务注册的可编辑快捷键（桌面版默认 Cmd/Ctrl+E，浏览器版默认 Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+E，Linux 浏览器默认未绑定） 在原生单行输入框与至少四行的多行输入框之间切换；输入框上沿的小 tab 常驻显示当前快捷键与目标模式；多行时 Enter 换行、Shift+Enter 发送，模式按设备记忆。

description.en: Agent skill and tool for querying multi-platform model account balances: DeepSeek, Doubao / Volcengine, Qwen / Alibaba Cloud, Hunyuan / Tencent Cloud, and custom HTTP endpoints. Read-only, with 60s cache.
description.zh: 多平台余额 Agent 技能与工具：查询 DeepSeek、豆包 / 火山引擎、千问 / 阿里云百炼、混元 / 腾讯云以及自定义 HTTP 接口的账户余额；只读，内置 60 秒缓存。

description.en: Meta's Muse Code CLI inside DSH: a composer switch starts muse serve, a right-sidebar panel and five chat tools (muse_open, muse_prompt, muse_read, muse_status, muse_interrupt) share one Muse session, approvals are decided only in the panel, and a local spend guard hard-stops at $10 by default. Windows only; needs the Muse Code CLI installed and signed in. The $10 cap is a local estimate for the muse serve this plugin starts.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里使用 Meta 的 Muse Code CLI：输入框开关启动 muse serve，右侧边栏面板与五个聊天工具（muse_open、muse_prompt、muse_read、muse_status、muse_interrupt）共享同一个 Muse 会话，审批只能在面板里决定，本地花费护栏默认到 $10 硬停止。仅限 Windows；需已装好并登录 Muse Code CLI。$10 上限为本机估算，只管本插件启动的 muse serve。

description.en: Music, audiobook, radio and news player for DeepSeek Harness: streams your local music folder over HTTP, reads local .txt/.epub novels aloud with AI voices, plays online QQ/Kugou/Netease music and internet radio (HLS supported), and broadcasts daily news digests — all driven from the UI or by telling the agent through the music_play model tool.
description.zh: DSH 音乐/小说播放器：在网页里听本地音乐（HTTP 流式）、用 AI 声音朗读本地小说（.txt/.epub）、播放在线 QQ/酷狗/网易云音乐与网络电台（支持 HLS 直播流）、定时播报每日新闻；可在面板操作，也可让 agent 通过 music_play 工具直接点播。

description.en: Electronic wooden fish in the bottom-right corner of the DSH web UI, a whale-girl sprite by default: tap the head to earn merit; it knocks by itself while the model is busy; per-session merit is stored locally, and the sprite can be swapped for custom art.
description.zh: 右下角电子木鱼，默认是鲸鱼娘图包：敲头记功德，模型忙碌时自动敲；功德按会话存本机，可换自定义图源。

description.en: Context lens: visualizes token usage of every request (context composition, KV cache hit rate) and enforces per-turn / per-session budgets with warning and blocking (npm: `dsh-my-context`).
description.zh: 上下文透镜：可视化每次请求的 token 用量（上下文构成、KV 缓存命中率），并提供每轮 / 每会话预算控制（超限提醒与拦截）（npm: `dsh-my-context`）。

description.en: Browser notifications and a beep when a session turn ends, the agent asks a question or approval is pending; clicking the notification jumps to the session; remote trigger endpoint and SSE channel (npm: `dsh-my-notify`).
description.zh: 会话（本轮）结束 / agent 询问 / 等待审批时弹浏览器通知 + 滴声，点击通知跳转会话；预留远程触发接口与 SSE 实时通道（npm: `dsh-my-notify`）。

description.en: Observability and git tooling: a persistent cross-session event audit log with a query API, a resource watchdog sidebar panel, structured Conventional Commits and pre-commit incremental diff review (npm: `dsh-my-observability`).
description.zh: 可观测性与 Git 工程工具：跨会话持久化的事件审计日志与查询 API、资源看门狗侧边栏面板、结构化 Conventional Commits 提交、提交前增量 diff 审查（npm: `dsh-my-observability`）。

description.en: Injects a per-session x-opencode-session header into opencode.ai inference requests, fixing the OpenCode Go gateway 400 MissingSessionID error; server-only, no UI (npm: `dsh-my-opencode-session-header`).
description.zh: 为 opencode.ai 的推理请求注入按会话稳定的 x-opencode-session 头，修复 OpenCode Go 网关 400 MissingSessionID；纯 server 插件，无界面（npm: `dsh-my-opencode-session-header`）。

description.en: Remote control: pushes ask / approval / session-end events to an external channel webhook and lets you answer, approve, query status or continue a session from your phone with token auth (npm: `dsh-my-remote`).
description.zh: 远程控制：把 ask / 审批 / 会话结束事件推送到外部通道 webhook，可用 token 鉴权在手机上回答问题、批准请求、查询状态或继续会话（npm: `dsh-my-remote`）。

description.en: Skill management: lists skills in global and per-project scopes and toggles each one per project; a disabled skill is not injected into that session (npm: `dsh-my-skill-manager`).
description.zh: Skill 管理：按全局 / 项目两个范围查看 skill 列表，并按项目启用或禁用；被禁用的 skill 不会注入该会话（npm: `dsh-my-skill-manager`）。

description.en: Edit the host-wide global instructions (~/.dsh/AGENTS.md) from a dedicated Customize page in Settings - every session on this machine applies them.
description.zh: 在设置页的「个性化」页编辑此主机全局指令（~/.dsh/AGENTS.md），此机器上的所有会话都会应用。

description.en: Keeps the NapCat QQ backend alive next to DSH: probes the OneBot 11 HTTP port at startup, launches NapCat when the port does not answer, then rechecks every 45 seconds, kills duplicate process chains, hides the console window, can create a logon scheduled task when a task name is set, and adds a settings page plus napcat_status, napcat_restart and napcat_dedupe tools. Optionally remembers the QQ password, behind a risk confirmation, so an expired fast-login token can be renewed without scanning a QR code. Windows only; without that scheduled task the launched QQ exits together with DSH.
description.zh: 让 NapCat 这个 QQ 后端跟着 DSH 一起活着：启动时探测 OneBot 11 的 HTTP 端口，连不上就拉起 NapCat，之后每 45 秒复查、清掉重复的进程链、隐藏控制台窗口、可在填写任务名后创建登录计划任务，并提供设置页以及 napcat_status、napcat_restart、napcat_dedupe 三个工具。可选记住 QQ 密码（默认关闭，开启前需确认风险），让失效的快速登录令牌不用扫码也能自己续上。仅 Windows；不建计划任务时，拉起的 QQ 会随 DSH 一起退出。

description.en: Controls user-authorized Chrome tabs from DeepSeek Harness through a local native-messaging broker, with semantic page reads, actions, screenshots, and explicit handoff.
description.zh: 通过本地原生消息 Broker，让 DeepSeek Harness 操作用户明确授权的 Chrome 标签页，支持语义化页面读取、交互、截图与显式交接。

description.en: Native per-workspace memory on the harness's own seams: facts and a bounded always-on profile on the storage-domain JSON unit, approval-gated writes with `(sessionId, seq)` citations, deterministic recall plus session-query FTS over past sessions — no external server, no custom SQLite.
description.zh: 基于 DSH 原生接缝的按工作区记忆：事实与有界常驻档案落在 storage-domain 的 JSON 单元上，写入经人工审批并带 `(sessionId, seq)` 引证，确定性召回 + session-query 全文检索历史会话——无外部服务器、无自建 SQLite。

description.en: Vertical message pointer rail on the left edge of the chat: one dash per user message, click to scroll to that message, hover for a preview bubble.
description.zh: 聊天区左侧的消息指针导轨：每条用户消息一个横条，点击滚动定位，悬停显示预览气泡。

description.en: Requirement-driven dsh plugin discovery and environment recipes: plugin_guide matches natural-language needs to a curated plugin directory with reasons and install commands; recipe installs whole setups (通知全家桶, 安全审计套装...) from bundled community bundles with ordered plans.
description.zh: 需求型插件导购与环境配方：plugin_guide 按自然语言需求语义匹配精选插件并给出理由与安装命令；recipe 一键安装整套社区配方（通知全家桶、安全审计套装等），带有序安装计划。

description.en: Keep branching from any completed answer at any depth while the main session stays untouched.
description.zh: 从任意层级的已完成回答持续创建隔离分支，主会话始终不受影响。

description.en: Route agent network requests through a local HTTP/CONNECT/SOCKS5 proxy.
description.zh: 让 agent 的网络请求走本机 HTTP/CONNECT/SOCKS5 代理。

description.en: Network and proxy doctor for DSH: checks system proxy settings, probes local proxy ports, detects TUN adapters, tests GitHub, TCP and HTTP reachability, scans hosts conflicts and prints concrete suggestions for what to change.
description.zh: DSH 的网络与代理诊断工具：检查系统代理设置、探测本地代理端口、识别 TUN 适配器、测试 GitHub/TCP/HTTP 连通性、扫描 hosts 冲突，并给出具体的修改建议。

description.en: Hosted tool server over MCP: invoice and bank-statement extraction with in-code arithmetic checks, ledger reconciliation in integer cents, PDF and table conversion, SQL dialect transpiling, and mainland-China reachability probes run from a China Mobile network vantage point.
description.zh: 托管工具服务器（MCP）：发票与银行流水提取并做代码内算术校验、按整数分对账、PDF 与表格转换、SQL 方言转写，以及从中国移动骨干网实测大陆可达性。

description.en: Authenticated LAN, Tailnet, and public HTTPS access for a DSH Host, with persistent host identity, pairing, and QR setup.
description.zh: 为 DSH Host 提供经认证的局域网、Tailnet 与公网 HTTPS 接入，支持持久主机身份、配对和二维码配置。

description.en: Standalone Network Engineer Assistant agent preset plus a bundled 32-doc command knowledge base skill for DPtech, H3C, Huawei and Ruijie switches and routers: KB-first retrieval, cross-vendor command translation, topology and CLI-output screenshot reading, online manual lookup with cited sources, and mandatory risk annotations for dangerous commands; answers networking topics only.
description.zh: 网络工程师助手预设 + 四厂商（迪普/新华三/华为/锐捷）交换机路由器命令知识库：32 篇文档随插件以技能形式分发（含来源链接与 verified 分级），KB 优先检索、跨厂商语法对照、拓扑与回显截图识别、联网查官方手册并注明出处、高危命令强制 ⚠️ 风险标注；只回答网络工程主题。

description.en: Visualize the DSH process network path on Windows or WSL with layered DNS/TCP/TLS/HTTP probes, detect stale proxy configuration, and apply snapshot-guarded repairs.
description.zh: 可视化 DSH 进程在 Windows 或 WSL 上的网络链路（DNS/TCP/TLS/HTTP 分层探测），检测失效的代理配置，并提供带快照回滚的安全修复。

description.en: Neumorphic DSH Web theme with light and dark palettes, ambient lighting, material shadows, grain texture, frosted-glass surfaces, and micro-interactions.
description.zh: DSH Web 轻拟物主题：提供浅色与深色配色、环境光影、材质阴影、纹理、磨砂玻璃表面与微交互。

description.en: New API gateway provider: several gateways with one active at a time, per-gateway model lists with context and modality details, quota, and image and video generation tools.
description.zh: New API 网关提供商：多网关同一时间激活一个，每个网关独立的模型清单与上下文/多模态标注、额度查询，以及生图与视频生成工具。

description.en: macOS system notifications for DeepSeek Harness: aborted, max-tokens, blocked, interrupted and error events, pending questions and approvals, and completion or subagent-end via terminal-notifier; clicking a banner opens a configured app and returning to the page auto-dismisses them.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 macOS 系统通知插件：任务中止、超限、阻塞、中断、出错、等待提问或批准、完成或子代理结束等事件通过 terminal-notifier 弹系统横幅；点击横幅打开指定应用，回到页面自动清空。

description.en: UI enhancement suite for DeepSeek Harness: one-click workspace open (copy path, reveal in Finder, open in an auto-discovered editor), DeepSeek-web-style user-message nav rail, session to-do marks, flat-list polish, and a hard-restart button.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 界面增强插件：工作区一键打开（复制路径、访达显示、自动发现编辑器打开）、用户消息导航条、会话待办标记、单列表增强与硬性重启按钮。

description.en: Approval sound effects from the movie NiuLai: plays 「妈妈」 when user confirmation is requested, interrupts it and plays 「牛来！」 the moment the user approves; native Windows playback, zero external dependencies.
description.zh: 牛来确认音：请求用户确认时播放「妈妈」，批准瞬间掐断并播放「牛来！」；梗源电影《牛来》，Windows 原生播放，零外部依赖。

description.en: Switch the current DSH session's model with a natural-language sentence, on web, TUI, or IM bridges (WeChat, Feishu), without touching the panel.
description.zh: 用一句自然语言切换当前 DSH 会话模型，可在 Web、TUI 及 IM 桥接的微信、飞书等对话框中使用，无需操作面板。

description.en: Sit-and-water reminder for DeepSeek Harness, with a cat that sits in the corner of the Web GUI. A focus cycle of 30-90 minutes ends in a centered overlay plus a triple chime that gets you up to walk and drink; the later button answers with one real sourced case about prolonged sitting and one about dehydration (built-in library of 17 entries, each with publisher, date and a link to the original); stopping produces a session report with worked time, completed rounds, successful interruptions, snoozes, suggested drinks and a good/mid/bad grade. The cat can be dragged anywhere with its position remembered and loops one animation per state. The timer and the ledger live in the host half, so a page refresh never loses a cycle; it only reminds while a DSH page is open. Cycle lengths, chime volume, cat opacity and grade thresholds are configurable on the plugin settings page.
description.zh: DSH 的久坐与喝水提醒：一只猫待在 Web GUI 角落帮你盯时间。专注周期 30-90 分钟结束后居中弹窗并连响三声，喊你起来走两步、喝口水；点「再等会」给出 1 条久坐的真实案例 + 1 条缺水的真实案例（内置 17 条，均带来源媒体、发布日期和原文链接）；点「结束」输出本次工作评价：工作时长、完成轮数、成功中断次数、推迟次数、建议喝水次数与好/中/差评分。猫可以拖到任意位置并记住位置，四个状态各一段循环动画。计时与账本在宿主侧，刷新页面不丢；只在 DSH 页面开着时提醒。周期时长、提示音音量、猫的不透明度、评价阈值都能在设置页调整。

description.en: Removes the Preview badge on DSH.
description.zh: 去除在DSH上的预览版标签。

description.en: Real-time 'We need…' and 'Let me…' reasoning-trajectory keyword stats for the DeepSeek Harness web chat.
description.zh: 实时追踪 DeepSeek Harness 网页对话中模型流式推理轨迹关键词统计的 UI 面板。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that lets you control Universal Robots (UR) collaborative arms directly from natural language, developed by Suzhou Nonead Robot Technology Co., Ltd. based on the same logic as the company's own nUR MCP Server. (Suzhou Nonead Robot Technology Co., Ltd.)
description.zh: 让 DSH 用自然语言直接控制 Universal Robots（UR）机械臂的插件，由拓德科技（Nonead）基于自研的 nUR MCP Server 同源逻辑开发。（Suzhou Nonead Robot Technology Co., Ltd.）

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that lets you control Universal Robots (UR) collaborative arms directly from natural language — by default an offline, kinematics-level simulated arm, with a real-robot channel that stays off until it is explicitly enabled. Needs a Python install with numpy and paramiko (pip install -r requirements.txt). Developed by Suzhou Nonead Robot Technology Co., Ltd. based on the same logic as the company's own nUR MCP Server. (Suzhou Nonead Robot Technology Co., Ltd.)
description.zh: 让 DSH 用自然语言直接控制 Universal Robots（UR）协作机械臂的插件——默认是一台离线、运动学级的仿真机械臂，真机通道在显式开启前始终关闭。需本机 Python 并 pip install -r requirements.txt（numpy、paramiko）。由拓德科技（Nonead）基于自研 nUR MCP Server 的同源逻辑开发。（Suzhou Nonead Robot Technology Co., Ltd.）

description.en: Connects DSH session status, approvals and questions to a native macOS notch app; requires the native app and Focus companion.
description.zh: 将 DSH 会话状态、审批和问题同步到原生 macOS 刘海程序，需要原生程序及 Focus 同步助手。

description.en: Companion for DSH Notch that synchronizes session navigation and read state with DSH Desktop and Web.
description.zh: DSH Notch 的配套助手，同步 Desktop、Web 与 Notch 之间的会话跳转和已读状态。

description.en: Workspace-wide sticky notes on an infinite canvas: notes are plain Markdown files, created manually, captured from conversations, or distilled by the AI, and can be handed back as context; ships 12 model tools and 5 bundled skills for creating, tagging, arranging, comparing and merging notes.
description.zh: 工作区级的无限画布便签：便签以 Markdown 文件保存，可手动创建、从对话中摘录或由 AI 提炼生成，并能作为上下文提供给 AI 使用；附带 12 个模型工具与 5 个内置技能，用于创建、打标签、整理、比较与合并便签。

description.en: Notes-backed context compression for DeepSeek Harness: replaces LLM-summarized compaction with a model-written persistent notebook plus recoverable raw history, so the rollover boundary itself costs zero model calls.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供笔记式上下文压缩：用模型维护的持久笔记本取代 LLM 摘要式压缩，并保留可恢复的原始历史，窗口边界本身不产生模型调用。

description.en: Turn the tab icon into a green/amber status light and send browser notifications when a session finishes or awaits your input, with 47 selectable notification sounds.
description.zh: 把标签页图标变成绿/琥珀状态灯，并在会话跑完或有交互待处理时发送浏览器通知，含 47 个可选音效。

description.en: Desktop and webhook alerts on macOS, Linux and Windows when an agent finishes a turn, errors, or waits for approval — zero-dependency native notifications (osascript / notify-send / PowerShell toast) plus a Slack-compatible webhook, with a configurable minimum turn duration.
description.zh: 桌面与 webhook 通知：任务完成、出错或等待审批时提醒；零依赖，走系统自带的 osascript / notify-send / PowerShell toast，并支持 Slack 兼容的 webhook，可配置最短回合时长。

description.en: DSH notification & remote-control plane: one `notify()` API across 28 outbound channels, six inbound control channels, phone approvals/questions/task control, a Native DSH Notify & Control UI, live outbound hot-apply, multi-agent routing, and zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: DSH 通知与远程操作控制面：一个 `notify()` API 接入 28 个出站渠道，六条入站控制通道承载手机审批、提问与任务控制；提供 DSH 原生「通知与控制」UI、出站热生效、多 agent 路由，并保持零运行时依赖。

description.en: Adds Windows-native toast notifications and a system tray icon to dsh: alerts when the agent finishes, stops, or errors, with a tray menu to reopen the web page or quit the background process.
description.zh: 为 dsh 添加 Windows 原生 Toast 通知与系统托盘图标：agent 完成、停止或出错时弹通知，托盘菜单可重新打开网页或退出后台进程。

description.en: Bark push notifications to iPhone: turn completion, waiting-for-input, and approval events sent from the DSH Host.
description.zh: Bark 推送通知到 iPhone：回合完成、等待回答、等待授权等事件由 Host 端发送。

description.en: Floating approval window for DeepSeek Harness that appears when you leave the app and hands the request back to the native card when you return. Windows-only (WPF via PowerShell). Independent fork of zeta987/dsh-notify-zeta (MIT); do not run alongside the upstream.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的独立审批浮窗：离开应用时弹出，切回时把请求交还原生卡片。仅 Windows（WPF/PowerShell）；独立分支自 zeta987/dsh-notify-zeta（MIT），不能与上游同时运行。
