description.en: Semantic code search for DeepSeek Harness: registers two native tools, semble_search (find code by describing its behaviour, returning ranked file:line hits) and semble_find_related (neighbours of a known location), which run the Semble CLI via uvx, plus one bundled routing skill. Requires uv on PATH; the first query on a repository builds its index.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的语义代码搜索：注册 semble_search（按行为描述检索代码，返回按相关度排序的 file:line 命中）与 semble_find_related（查找已知位置的相邻代码）两个原生工具，检索由 uvx 启动的 Semble CLI 完成，并附一个随包分发的路由技能。需要 PATH 中有 uv；对某个仓库的首次查询会建立索引。

description.en: Beta 0.2.0-beta.2 for DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 only, for Host-owner use. Search original user and assistant text in the current session or same-directory workspace, with source coordinates and context. Non-owner session authorization is not supported.
description.zh: 0.2.0-beta.2 仅支持 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2，面向宿主所有者使用。在当前会话或同目录工作区搜索用户与助手原文，查看来源坐标和上下文；不支持非所有者身份的会话级授权。

description.en: Sensitive-character replacement for DeepSeek Harness: matches messages and tool results against a YAML blocklist you maintain (global, per provider id, or per model) before the model reads them, and scrubs the outgoing request again before dispatch, so blocked characters cannot trip the official API Content Exists Risk 400.
description.zh: 在模型读取内容之前，按用户维护的 YAML 屏蔽表（全局 / 按 Provider ID / 按模型）替换消息与工具结果中的敏感字符，出网前再清洗一次请求，避免 DeepSeek 官方 API 的 Content Exists Risk 400。

description.en: Ten interoceptive senses for a DSH agent: workspace pulse, time, affect, needs, expression, silence, residue, open loops, body and face — deterministic state that keeps moving on its own.
description.zh: 给 DSH 智能体的十种内感受：房子脉搏、时间、情绪、需求、表达、沉默、余味、未闭合的事、身体与表情——各自持续演进的确定性状态。

description.en: Read-only Sentry tools: project listing, issue search at organization or project scope, single issue detail, and the latest or a specific event with a trimmed stacktrace. Local variables, request headers and bodies, query strings, packages and secret-looking tags are removed before the event reaches the model, and oversized events degrade through source context, breadcrumbs and frames rather than failing.
description.zh: 面向 Sentry 的只读工具：项目列表、组织或项目范围的议题搜索、单个议题详情，以及最新或指定 event 的裁剪后堆栈。局部变量、请求头与请求体、查询字符串、依赖清单以及疑似机密的 tag 会在 event 交给模型前移除；超大 event 会依次降级源码上下文、面包屑与栈帧，而不是直接失败。

description.en: ServerChan3 (Server酱) push notifications when a turn finishes — title, model, project directory, git branch, status and a reply excerpt, with subagent filtering and fire-and-forget delivery.
description.zh: 回合结束时向 Server酱3 推送微信通知——标题、模型、项目目录、Git 分支、状态与回复摘要，支持子代理过滤，fire-and-forget 不阻塞主流程。

description.en: Manage the dsh service via `dsh --profile ctl`: systemd lifecycle (install, start, stop, restart, enable, disable, uninstall), persisted config, health probe and logs, plus shell completions and self-update.
description.zh: 通过 `dsh --profile ctl` 管理 DSH 服务：systemd 生命周期（安装、启停、重启、自启、卸载）、持久化配置、健康探测与日志，附带 shell 补全与自更新。

description.en: Monitor the account balance for 3rd-party services those AI agents often use, such as Tavily, SerpAPI, Firecrawl, Bocha, Tinyfish, etc. Optionally you can select to inject the account balance into the system prompt, so the agent can use the services accordingly.
description.zh: 监控 AI Agents 常用的第三方服务余额，如 Tavily、SerpAPI、Firecrawl、博查、Tinyfish 等。可选支持将服务的余额注入 System Prompt，以便 Agent 合理使用相关服务。

description.en: Sidebar conversation actions: open the row menu on right-click, rename by double-click, copy the session id, and delete a conversation together with its storage after a confirmation.
description.zh: 侧边栏会话操作：右键打开行菜单、双击重命名、复制会话 ID，以及二次确认后连同存储一起删除会话。

description.en: Desktop notification and sound when a turn completes, the agent asks a question, or an approval is requested, each independently toggleable, plus an activity ball that lists live sessions and jumps back to one.
description.zh: 跑完 / 提问 / 需要审批时弹桌面通知与提示音（三类可分别开关），另附活动悬浮球，点会话行直接跳回该会话。

description.en: Session bridge for DeepSeek Harness: drive other real DSH sessions straight from your prompt — create top-level sessions in any workspace, message or steer any session, wait for replies and stream them segment-by-segment (chain-of-thought included), resume offline sessions, find sessions across workspaces, run a background watchdog that monitors and schedules a main task (nudge when stalled, correct drift, cancel when stuck), and archive sessions with one command.
description.zh: 会话桥：让当前 agent 直接用提示词驱动其它真实的 DSH 会话——跨工作区创建主会话、向任意会话发消息或注入 steering、等待并逐段读取回复（含思维链）、恢复离线会话、按名称或 id 跨工作区查找会话；还能用后台看门狗监控并调度主任务（卡住催办、偏离纠偏、卡死终止），一键归档会话。

description.en: Adds per-Workspace category trees to the Web sidebar, with nested categories, drag-and-drop session assignment, category-scoped session creation, and category deletion that archives contained sessions.
description.zh: 为 Web 侧边栏添加按 Workspace 隔离的分类树，支持嵌套分类、拖拽归类会话、在分类中新建会话，以及删除分类时归档其中的会话。

description.en: Right-click any session row in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar to color-tag it with a default red, ten palette colors or a custom picker, persisted locally.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏会话行加右键标色：默认红色、十色色板与自定义取色，颜色本地持久化。

description.en: Colors each DSH sidebar session title by state: unread (blue while the model is running, green once it has finished) and pinned (yellow, read from DSH's own pinned set), composed into one left-to-right gradient. Pinning, archiving and ordering stay with DSH itself — the plugin reimplements no pinning and rewrites no official bundle — and a settings section lists every unread session.
description.zh: 按状态给 DSH 侧栏会话标题上色：未读（模型运行中＝蓝、已跑完＝绿）与置顶（黄，读取 DSH 官方置顶集合），两者合成一条从左到右的渐变。置顶、归档与排序由 DSH 官方提供，本插件不重复实现置顶、也不改写官方 bundle；另含列出全部未读会话的设置分节。

description.en: Injects a small continuity pointer at the start of a new session, naming the previous session and any handoff file, and reuses DSH's own compaction summary when there is no handoff file.
description.zh: 新会话开始时注入一条很小的接续指针，说明上一个会话是谁、工作区有没有交接文档；没有交接文档时复用 DSH 已有的压缩摘要。

description.en: Add one session-header button to copy the session deep link, the full conversation as Markdown, or the working directory.
description.zh: 在会话标题栏添加一个复制按钮，可复制会话深度链接、整段对话 Markdown 或工作目录。

description.en: Cross-session messaging: sends text into another session in the same workspace, and creates new top-level sessions.
description.zh: 跨会话投递：往同工作区的另一个会话发消息，并可新建顶层会话。

description.en: Drag a session onto another workspace in the DSH sidebar and it really moves: the session-log header cwd is rewritten and the log directory is re-homed under the target project, with a progress bar while it runs.
description.zh: 在 DSH 左侧栏把会话拖到别的工作区，归属真的会变：改写会话日志 header 的 cwd 并把日志目录迁到目标项目下，迁移过程中显示进度条。

description.en: Session evidence reports: /transcript writes styled HTML / Markdown / JSON reports from canonical logs, /stats prints a terminal stats card, /archive writes per-session ZIPs.
description.zh: 会话证据报告：/transcript 从权威日志生成 HTML/Markdown/JSON 报告，/stats 输出终端统计卡，/archive 打包单会话 ZIP。

description.en: Ctrl+F find-in-session for the conversation, powered by the session store rather than the DOM - labels every hit by source (you / assistant / reasoning / tool call / tool result / system), groups results by turn, merges identical snippets, offers prose-vs-everything scope, regex / case / whole-word options, highlights all matches, and copies or exports the result set as Markdown.
description.zh: 会话内 Ctrl+F 全文查找（读会话 store 而非 DOM）：命中按来源分类（你/助手/思考/工具调用/工具输出/系统）、按轮次分组、同文合并，可切「只搜正文 / 搜全部内容」，支持正则/大小写/全词，全量高亮，并能把结果复制或导出为 Markdown。

description.en: One-level session folders for the web sidebar - group sessions per workspace, move them by drag-and-drop or context menu, archive and restore, server-side persistence.
description.zh: 为网页侧边栏提供单层会话文件夹——按工作区分组会话，支持拖拽或右键菜单移动、归档与恢复，数据在服务端持久化。

description.en: Session hotkeys for the DSH Web GUI: switch sessions like browser tabs (positional Alt+1-9, pinned slots, previous/next, new/archive/rename), keyboard model switching via Alt+M, alternate send, Esc focus hand-off, and Alt+W to close or restore a dsh-split-screen workspace — all rebindable with Windows/macOS presets. Verified on DSH 0.1.1 and 0.1.5.
description.zh: Web 会话热键插件：像切浏览器标签页一样用键盘管理会话——Alt+1-9 顺序切换、固定槽位、上/下一个、新建/归档/重命名、Alt+M 键盘切换模型与备用发送、Esc 焦点交接，Alt+W 关闭/恢复 dsh-split-screen 工作区；键位可在面板录制重绑，Windows/macOS 双预设。已适配 DSH 0.1.1 与 0.1.5。

description.en: Sidebar session-title icons: an auxiliary model call on the same route as title generation draws a 24x24 monochrome SVG metaphor shown before each session row title, with disk caching.
description.zh: 侧边栏会话标题图标：标题生成时用同一路由的辅助模型调用画一枚 24×24 单色 SVG 隐喻图标，显示在每行标题左侧，带磁盘缓存。

description.en: Adds an Inherit row to the session menu: mechanically extracts concrete anchors (task, recent instructions, files edited, recent failures, commands, todos) from a long session into a handoff and continues in a clean session, with the same preset, no history copied and no model call.
description.zh: 会话菜单新增「继承」：把长会话里的具体锚点（任务原文、最近的用户指令、改过的文件、最近的失败、命令、待办）机械提取成交接单，在干净的新会话里接着干——预设默认一并继承，不复制历史，也不调用模型。

description.en: Session board in the left sidebar: every chat session's current work, todos and progress, with a searchable overview heatmap and one-click navigation back to the session.
description.zh: 在左侧栏提供会话看板：集中展示每个会话的当前工作、待办与进度，附带可搜索的概览热力图，点击卡片即可跳回会话。

description.en: A session manager for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: per-workspace category trees with drag-and-drop ordering, pinned sessions hoisted above the categories (or kept inside them, switchable from the view options), an archive partition, and a delete bin where removed sessions keep their logs and can be restored or purged in batches. The host half owns the category and recycle data, the web half renders it; both ship as one plugin. Maintained fork of ht719/dsh-session-categories ported to current DSH, with pinning, archive partition and delete bin added; it cannot be installed together with the original.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧栏的会话管理插件：按工作区划分的分类树，支持拖拽排序；置顶会话可抬到分类上方，也可按开关留在所属分类内；另有归档分区，以及删除回收站——删掉的会话日志留存，可恢复或批量彻底清除。宿主半边掌管分类与回收站数据，网页半边负责渲染，两者作为一个插件一起发布。本插件是 ht719/dsh-session-categories 的维护分叉，已移植到当前 DSH 并新增置顶、归档分区与删除回收站；不能与原版同时安装。

description.en: Keeps the most recently used sessions resident in the browser so switching back reuses the already loaded history instead of re-reading it; the number of resident sessions is configurable and the plugin can be switched off.
description.zh: 让浏览器最近用过的会话保持常驻：切走再切回来直接复用已加载的历史、不再重新读取；常驻数量可配置，并可整体关闭。

description.en: Purges billion-context snapshots left behind after a session is deleted in DeepSeek Harness, and can also clean up cost-meter ledger rows (off by default).
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中删除会话后，清理 billion-context 快照；cost-meter 账本记录的清理默认关闭，可在设置里打开。

description.en: Session insights and one-click shareable HTML replay for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的会话洞察，并可一键导出为可分享的 HTML 回放。

description.en: Copy and open `dsh://` session deep links, or paste them into another conversation to inject a bounded, read-only snapshot of the referenced session.
description.zh: 复制、打开 `dsh://` 会话深链，或将其粘贴到另一对话中，注入被引用会话的受限只读快照。

description.en: Move, archive, restore, portable backup/export and import sessions across workspaces in the DeepSeek Harness web UI.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中跨工作区移动、归档、恢复、可携式备份/导出与导入会话。

description.en: Cross-version session migration for DSH: sweeps legacy session stores (v0 plaintext, .zstd and .zip exports), re-pins the header cwd to the target workspace and drops sessions in so the persistence layer upgrades them on open; settings sidebar with env/import/list/convert tabs plus a CLI (check / fix / import).
description.zh: DSH 会话跨版本迁移：扫描旧版会话目录（v0 明文、.zstd 与 .zip 导出包），改写 header cwd 绑定目标工作区并落盘，打开会话时由持久化层自动完成版本升级；设置侧边栏（环境 / 导入 / 列表 / 转换）加 CLI（check / fix / import）。

description.en: Manage DSH sessions the way Windows Explorer manages files: folder tree, tags, notes, recycle bin. Folders, tags and notes live in a separate index; deleting a session moves its directory to the plugin recycle bin, and cutting across workspaces moves the file and rewrites its cwd.
description.zh: 像 Windows 资源管理器那样管理 DSH 的会话：目录树、标签、备注、回收站。文件夹、标签、备注存在独立索引里；删除会话会把其目录移入插件回收站，跨工作区剪切会移动会话文件并改写其 cwd。

description.en: Desktop notifications for DSH Web sessions: browser notifications plus Windows toast when a session finishes, fails, needs an approval, or asks a question. Clicking one opens the session; browser notifications focus an open tab, Windows toasts open a new tab.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 会话提供桌面通知：会话完成、失败、需要审批或提问时发送浏览器通知，在 Windows/WSL 下同时弹出系统 Toast；点击通知定位到对应会话（浏览器通知聚焦已打开标签页，Toast 新开标签页）。

description.en: Copies a session log path (or a paste-ready handoff block) and turns the multi-frame zstd log into a readable file another session can continue from.
description.zh: 复制会话日志路径（或可直接粘贴的接续块），并把多帧 zstd 会话日志转成可读文件，供另一个会话读取接续。

description.en: Pin sessions and workspaces to the top of the Web sidebar with per-pin row colors, a header toggle and a pinned panel; 0.4.0 adds a navigation organizer — pin groups (boards), tags and saved filter views, session health summaries, and /goto.
description.zh: 把会话与工作区置顶到 Web 侧边栏顶部：行级图钉与换色、会话头开关、已置顶面板；0.4.0 再加导航组织器——Pin 分组（boards）、标签与保存视图、会话健康摘要与 /goto。

description.en: Sidebar archive directory for DSH Web: restore a session to its original workspace slot, delete the session log, or edit-and-branch a user message into a new conversation.
description.zh: DSH Web 侧栏归档目录：将会话恢复到原工作区槽位、删除会话日志，或从用户消息修改并分支为新会话。

description.en: Full-type session lifecycle management: one-shot subagents archived on completion, idle continuable subagents / main sessions archived (recoverable), a capacity cap, projection-cache cleanup, and a hot-reload settings panel.
description.zh: 全类型会话生命周期管理：一次性子 agent 完成后归档，闲置的可续聊子 agent 与主会话归档（可恢复），容量上限、投影缓存清理，以及热重载设置面板。

description.en: Sidebar unread / waiting / status hub for DSH Web: a bell jumps to the next unread session, a shortcut walks sessions waiting for input, and ⌘⇧, / ⌘⇧. step back and forward through the conversations you have visited; one overlay lists unread and pending sessions side by side; a six-metric readout at the sidebar foot makes every icon a button that jumps to the next session of that kind; a host-side ledger keeps the account across restarts, so an unread session keeps its green row dot after a restart, and a startup dialog offers to re-send a continue message to sessions whose turn was cut off.
description.zh: DSH Web 侧边栏的未读、待办与状态读数中枢：铃铛按顺序定位未读会话，快捷键依次走到正在等你输入的会话，⌘⇧, / ⌘⇧. 在访问过的对话之间前后切换；另有总览把未读与待决策会话分两区铺开；底部一行六项会话状态读数，每个图标都能点，点了跳到下一个同类会话；账本落在 host 半边，重启也不丢——未读会话重启后仍然显示行内绿色小标，启动时还会把上次被切断的会话列成清单，一键重发续跑消息。

description.en: Progress tab for the DSH right sidebar: the turn status of the session and the progress long-running tasks reported, in one tab beside the conversation.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏的进度页：会话每一轮的状态与长任务上报的进度集中在一个 tab 里，和对话并排看。

description.en: Live CNY cost of the current session under the composer, priced per assistant message by the model that produced it and the peak or off-peak window of its own timestamp, with a Settings page that edits the six prices of every model and marks a model with no rate card with a leading tilde because it is costed from the Flash rates.
description.zh: 在输入框下方实时显示当前会话的人民币费用，每条消息按其自身时间戳与该条所用模型的峰谷单价计价；设置页可编辑每个模型的六项单价，未定价的模型按 Flash 单价估算并以 ~ 标注。

description.en: Recycle bin for DSH sessions: sidebar delete icons, multi-select restore and permanent delete, live-session protection.
description.zh: DSH 会话回收站：侧边栏删除图标、多选还原与彻底删除、活跃会话保护。

description.en: Cross-session reference (mention) plugin — paste @[label](dsh-session:…) into any session, including one in another workspace, and the host injects the referenced session snapshot for the model to read; includes a one-click copy-reference button.
description.zh: 跨会话引用插件：在任意会话（含其他工作区）粘贴 @[label](dsh-session:…) 引用，宿主注入被引用会话的快照供模型阅读，并提供一键复制引用按钮。

description.en: Adds a session_rename tool so an AI can retitle the DeepSeek Harness session it is running in.
description.zh: 新增 session_rename 工具，让 AI 能重命名自己所在的 DSH 会话。

description.en: Diagnose and safely repair corrupted DSH session history: raw zstd/JSONL validation, tool-call ID repair, single-slot pre-repair backup, restore, and an audit trail.
description.zh: 诊断并安全修复损坏的 DSH 会话历史：raw zstd/JSONL 校验、tool-call ID 修复、单槽 pre-repair 备份与恢复、审计记录。

description.en: After official llm-retry (n/5) gives up, keep retrying transient API failures (timeout, transport, rate-limit, 5xx, dropped SSE) on the same open step until success, cancel, or pause; AUTH, QUOTA, and user Stop are never retried.
description.zh: 官方 llm-retry（n/5）耗尽后，对超时/传输/限流/5xx/SSE 断流等瞬时失败在同一打开 step 上继续重试直到成功、取消或暂停；认证失败、额度耗尽和用户停止不会重试。

description.en: Scan, view, and safely clean local AI terminal session histories (Claude Code, Codex CLI, WorkBuddy, DSH) from a settings card — quarantine-first with SHA-256 manifests, one-click restore, audit log, and phrase-confirmed hard delete.
description.zh: 会话清道夫：在 DSH 设置中扫描、查看并安全清理本机 AI 终端会话历史（Claude Code、Codex CLI、WorkBuddy、DSH），隔离优先、带 SHA-256 清单与一键整批恢复，彻底删除需输入确认短语。

description.en: Copy session IDs, send messages to live or saved sessions, and view session token usage.
description.zh: 复制会话 ID、向在线或已保存的会话发送消息，并查看会话 token 用量。

description.en: Shows every session theme in the DSH Web left sidebar immediately on page load by warming the session projection cache at startup; no need to click into a conversation first.
description.zh: 打开页面时左侧边栏直接显示每个会话的主题，无需点进会话。启动时预热会话投影缓存，让冷会话也能显示真实标题。

description.en: Session timeline down the left of the conversation: every user message at a glance, current-message tracking, hover preview of the message and its reply, click to jump, collapsible.
description.zh: 会话左侧的短横线时间轴：整个会话的用户消息一览、当前消息定位、悬停预览消息与回复、点击跳转，可收起展开。

description.en: Reformats dsh session titles as "date | type | topic" (type and topic are summarized by a model from the full conversation), and hides unused sessions from the sidebar without deleting them.
description.zh: 把 dsh 会话标题统一成「日期｜类型｜主题」（类型与主题由模型对整段对话总结），并支持可逆的会话隐藏：暂时不用的会话从侧边栏收起，不删除、随时一键显示回来。

description.en: Consolidated toolkit for session identity, global & workspace prompts with referenced files, session auto-resume, UAC-free web restart, and peer-session messaging.
description.zh: 整合工具包：会话身份、全局/工作区提示词（含引用文件）、会话自动上线、免 UAC 网页重启、会话间消息。

description.en: Session Workbench: full-text search past sessions, recall up to 3 as @references, and manage conversation-view tabs (show/hide + drag reorder).
description.zh: 会话工作台：全文搜索历史会话、一键 @引用 召回最多 3 个，并管理会话视图标签栏（显示/隐藏 + 拖拽排序）。

description.en: Session management enhancement plugin for DeepSeek Harness - workspace session count display, archived sessions panel with restore/delete, drag-and-drop session move across workspaces.
description.zh: DSH 会话管理增强插件 - 工作区会话数展示、归档会话面板（支持恢复/删除）、拖拽移动会话到其他工作区。

description.en: Normalize the DSH settings UI onto one design language: unified typography, cards, controls, focus and motion across every settings page, including pages contributed by other plugins.
description.zh: 将 DSH 设置界面归一为同一套设计语言：统一各设置页的排版、卡片、控件、焦点与动效，包括其他插件贡献的页面。

description.en: Moves and resizes the DeepSeek Harness settings panel; its position and size are remembered per browser.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的设置面板可以自由拖动与缩放，位置与尺寸按浏览器记忆。

description.en: Adds edit mode to the DSH settings nav for drag-reordering, per-section show/hide and named collapsible drawer grouping saved in the plugin's own settings namespace, plus pinning up to five sections to the main sidebar for one-click access.
description.zh: 为 DSH 设置页导航加编辑模式：拖拽排序、逐个显隐、用命名可折叠抽屉分组，排版存在插件自己的设置命名空间；还能把最多 5 个分区钉到主界面侧栏，一键直达。

description.en: Reorder the settings panel nav by long-pressing and dragging a section: the dragged row turns translucent and follows the pointer, the order is saved to the plugin's own folder, and uninstalling restores the official order.
description.zh: 长按拖动即可重排设置面板左侧大项：被拖项半透明并跟随指针，顺序保存在插件自己的目录而非 settings.yaml，卸载后自动恢复官方原序。

description.en: Declutter the DSH settings nav: fold third-party plugin entries under collapsible group rows, with bookmark-style custom groups, a fold toggle, and auto classification (market tags → name rules → your AI model).
description.zh: 设置面板导航整理：第三方插件入口折叠为可展开的分组行，支持书签式自定义分组、折叠开关与自动分类（市场标签 → 名称规则 → AI 模型三级兜底）。

description.en: ShiGuang Memory Engine (SGME) bridge: multi-agent shared long-term memory via HTTP — L0/L1/L1.5/L2 distillation, scenario-based injection, unified search, and proactive care signals (memory_search / wiki_search / signal_pull / signal_claim / signal_ack), installable as `dsh-sgme`.
description.zh: 拾光记忆引擎（SGME）桥接：多智能体共享长期记忆（HTTP）—— L0/L1/L1.5/L2 分层提炼、按场景注入、统一检索、主动关怀信号（memory_search / wiki_search / signal_pull / signal_claim / signal_ack），npm 包名 `dsh-sgme`。

description.en: Share your conversations with one click.
description.zh: 一键分享你的对话。

description.en: Publish TXT, Markdown, HTML, PDF, Word, and PowerPoint files as ShareOne links with passwords, watermarks, text-page updates, and TXT/Markdown/HTML comments.
description.zh: 将 TXT、Markdown、HTML、PDF、Word 和 PowerPoint 文件发布为 ShareOne 分享链接，支持访问密码、水印、文本页面更新和 TXT/Markdown/HTML 评论。

description.en: Replaces the stock bash/pwsh terminal rows in the DSH web UI with shell command cards: long commands soft-wrap with line numbers instead of truncating, plus separate copy-command and copy-output buttons.
description.zh: 用自定义 Shell 命令卡片替换 DSH Web 原版 bash/pwsh 工具行：长命令自动换行带行号不再截断，并提供独立的复制命令/复制输出按钮。

description.en: Ecommerce operator workbench: CSV batch preview with marketplace column adapters, reproducible profit/six-dimension scoring, public product-page snapshots, Chinese skills, and a replaceable store-policy KB.
description.zh: 电商店主工作台：CSV 批量预览（多平台列适配）、可复算利润与六维评分、公开商品页快照、中文 skills、可替换售后政策知识库。

description.en: Turns the latest completed DSH session turn into a shareable vertical recap video: editable five-scene storyboard, host-side privacy redaction, optional AI polish and TTS narration, MP4/WebM export with PNG cover.
description.zh: 把最近一次已完成的 DSH 任务生成为可分享的竖屏战报视频：五幕可编辑故事板、Host 侧脱敏、可选 AI 润色与配音，导出 MP4/WebM 和 PNG 封面。

description.en: Fan-made wallpaper plugin themed on the streamer Zhang Shunfei: full-screen high-definition rotating colorful pegasus GIF wallpaper with theme blending and prominence control, plus a Bilibili music player (add songs by pasting a link, delete, volume, seek, single/list/shuffle loop, and a sidebar mini player).
description.zh: 以网络主播张顺飞为主题的粉丝同人二创壁纸插件：彩色飞马高清旋转动图全屏壁纸，支持主题融合与突出度调节；附带 B站音乐播放器，可粘贴链接添加歌曲、删除、调音量、拖进度条、切换单曲/列表/随机循环，并有侧栏迷你播放器。

description.en: Shut down Windows automatically after DeepSeek Harness tasks complete — a floating arm button plus a cancellable countdown banner (shutdown /a), zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 任务完成后自动关机：右下角按钮开启模式，任务成功完成后进入可取消的倒计时（取消走 shutdown /a），零运行时依赖。

description.en: Select part of a conversation and ask about it in a right-side side chat; bring AI replies back to the main chat directly or as a summary.
description.zh: 选中对话片段，在右侧面板的侧边聊天中提问（按会话隔离）；AI 回复可原文或摘要后带回主会话。

description.en: Multi-tab side chat for DeepSeek Harness. Quote a whole message or text selected from a still-streaming reply into a side chat without waiting for the reply to finish, and dock the panel over the better-sidebar workbench or yield to the conversation depending on the sidebar state.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 多标签侧聊增强：可引用整条消息，也可在回复生成中选中文本追问（无需等待回复完成）；右侧停靠面板随 better-sidebar 开关在覆盖与让位间自动切换。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that shows the DeepSeek API account balance and OpenCode Go plan usage (consumption ring, hover details) in the sidebar footer, with adaptive polling and zh/en locale support.
description.zh: DSH Web 插件:在侧边栏底部显示 DeepSeek API 余额与 OpenCode Go 套餐用量(消耗圆环、悬浮详情),自适应轮询,支持中英文。

description.en: Delete sessions for real from the dsh sidebar (local logs and projection cache included, subagent and fork children cascade) and manage workspaces and ungrouped sessions, with an optional daily cleanup of ungrouped sessions.
description.zh: 在 dsh 侧栏真正删除会话（连带本地日志与投影缓存，子代理与 fork 子会话级联）并管理工作区与未分组会话，可选每天定时清理未分组会话。

description.en: A file-view enhancement plugin that extends the official DSH sidebar, providing source view, in-place editing, line number display, search, and font zoom.
description.zh: 基于 DSH 官方侧边栏的文件视图增强插件，提供源码视图、原位编辑、行号显示、搜索和字体缩放功能。

description.en: Split the DSH sidebar workspace list into Active, Session tasks and Inactive sections with manual pins and an activity threshold, keeping the official search, archive filters, row menus and drag and drop, with a one-click switch back to the shipped list. The Session tasks section uses a fixed Windows workspace at D:\files\history-tasks; other platforms must create that directory manually.
description.zh: 把 DSH 侧栏工作区列表分为「活跃 / 会话任务 / 不活跃」三段，支持手动钉住与活跃阈值，保留官方搜索、归档筛选、行菜单与拖拽，并可一键切回官方列表。「会话任务」段固定用 Windows 路径 D:\files\history-tasks，其他平台需自行预建该目录。

description.en: DeepSeek account wallet balance and the current peak or off-peak billing period, in a fixed status region at the sidebar foot, with a manual refresh and an official top-up link.
description.zh: 侧边栏底部固定状态区：DeepSeek 账号钱包余额、当前计费时段（高峰/空闲）、手动刷新与官方充值入口。

description.en: Sidebar todo list for DeepSeek Harness — grouped buckets, recurring tasks with weekday or month-day rules, a month-view calendar, and an agent tool that reads and writes the same JSON file.
description.zh: 侧栏待办清单——逾期/今天/本周分组、循环任务（每周多选周几、每月指定几号）、月视图日历，agent 通过工具读写同一份 JSON。

description.en: Adds a restart row to Settings → General that relaunches dsh web with the same invocation through a detached helper, refuses under a detected systemd supervisor unless allowRestart is true, and tests whether the listening port is free by connecting to it rather than binding it.
description.zh: 在「设置 → 通用」增加一行重启按钮：用相同启动参数、经分离的 helper 重新拉起 dsh web；检测到 systemd 监管时默认拒绝（除非 allowRestart 为 true）；判断端口是否空闲用连接探测而非绑定。

description.en: Declutters the DSH chat: hides agent execution-log rows, tightens spacing and fonts, wraps messages in bubbles, and injects an editable reply-concisely system instruction.
description.zh: 简化 DSH 聊天界面：隐藏执行日志、收紧间距与字号、把消息做成气泡，并注入可编辑的“简洁回复”系统指令。

description.en: Archives DSH conversation output into SiYuan notes: a single siyuan_archive call files content under `<archive path>/<year-month>/<type>/<date>_<time>_<topic>_<content>` with a metadata table and auto-maintains an index document at the notebook root; 6 siyuan_* host tools (list notebooks, full-text search, read document, archive, delete block, remove document) and a Web settings page for base URL with connection test, API token in the host credential store, archive target and title template, plus notebook/document-level read/write/delete permissions with default deny and child levels able to only tighten.
description.zh: 把 DSH 对话产出归档到思源笔记：一次 siyuan_archive 调用按「<归档路径>/<年-月>/<类型>/<日期>_<时间>_<主题>_<内容>」写入并附元数据表，自动维护笔记本根的「索引与规范」索引文档；6 个 siyuan_* 宿主工具（列笔记本、全文检索、读文档、归档、删块、删文档）与 Web 设置页配置地址（含测试连接）、存宿主凭据库的 API token、归档目标与标题模板，以及按笔记本/文档的读写删权限（默认全拒、子级只能收紧）。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to a local SiYuan (思源笔记) desktop app: registers its note tools as mcp__siyuan__<tool>, exposes the AI configured in SiYuan together with its agent loop as one more tool, ships a notes skill, and enforces a readonly/authoring/full profile on every call while keeping the tool list available when the app is closed.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接到本机思源笔记桌面端：把笔记工具注册为 mcp__siyuan__<tool>，额外把思源里配置好的 AI 与其 agent 回路也做成一个工具（按档位门禁），附带笔记使用技能，并在每次调用上执行只读/创作/完整三级策略；思源关闭时工具列表依然可用。

description.en: Handwriting and diagram whiteboard: sketch on a floating or sidebar canvas and attach the cropped image to your message.
description.zh: 手写公式、画示意图的画板：浮动或侧栏画布，导出裁切后的图片作为消息附件。

description.en: Ships a skill about writing DSH skills - SKILL.md frontmatter and root precedence, how to phrase a description so it actually triggers, length and splitting rules, and an A/B check that the finished skill changes agent behaviour. The package also carries the checker the skill uses to validate a skill directory.
description.zh: 携带一份讲怎么写 DSH 技能的技能——SKILL.md 的 frontmatter 与技能根优先级、description 怎么写才会被触发、篇幅与拆分标准，以及「写完后怎么证明它真管用」的 A/B 验证。包里还带着供这份技能校验技能目录的检查脚本。

description.en: Interior and exterior ballistics paper reproduction and code generation skill. Requires LibreOffice Kit for PDF rendering and a vision API key (e.g. Qwen-VL) for formula OCR.
description.zh: 内/外弹道学的论文复现与代码编写 skill。前置：LibreOffice Kit（PDF 渲染）+ 视觉 API key（如千问，公式 OCR）。

description.en: Browse, preview and install public Agent Skills from inside the DSH web GUI, aggregating five sources (claudeskills.info, skillsmp.com, the awesome-claude-skills repository list, the official anthropics/skills repo, and skill packs shipped by installed DSH plugins). Skills install pinned to a commit rather than a branch name, so what you previewed is what lands; the panel reports provenance, whole-tree update checks and a trash instead of deleting. Before writing anything it validates the skill name and frontmatter against the rules the harness silently enforces, lists files that SKILL.md references but the fetch did not bring, flags partial fetches, and offers overwrite, rename or skip when a name is taken.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 里浏览、预览并安装公开的 Agent Skills，聚合五个来源（claudeskills.info、skillsmp.com、awesome-claude-skills 仓库坐标表、Anthropic 官方仓库、已装 DSH 插件自带的技能包）。安装按 commit 而不是分支名钉住，预览到的就是落地的；面板给出每个技能的来路、按整棵树比对的更新检查，删除是移进回收站而不是抹掉。落地之前先按 harness 实际执行的规则体检技能名与 frontmatter（名字不合法会被 harness 静默跳过），列出 SKILL.md 引用但没取回的文件，标出只取到一部分的情况，同名时给出覆盖、改名、跳过三个选项。

description.en: Mounts external skill directories (Claude Code, Codex, ZCode) into DSH as read-only skill providers: frontmatter field mapping, name slug normalization and hot reload.
description.zh: 技能兼容层：把 Claude Code / Codex / ZCode 的技能目录挂载为 dsh 的只读技能提供方——支持 frontmatter 字段映射、名称 slug 规范化与热重载。

description.en: Agent-managed procedural memory: a skill_manage tool that creates, patches, disables and deletes the agent's own skills in user or project scope, with delete guards (agent-created marker, pin, path confinement) and a trigger-discipline prompt.
description.zh: 代理自管的程序性记忆：skill_manage 工具可创建、修补、禁用、删除 agent 自己的技能（用户级/项目级双作用域），带删除守卫（agent 创建标记、pin、路径限制）与触发纪律提示。

description.en: Skill marketplace with unified search across SkillHub and ClawHub, in-app README preview, one-click install and uninstall, an installed-skill list, and a chat-input skill picker.
description.zh: 技能市场插件，聚合 SkillHub 与 ClawHub 双源搜索，支持站内 README 预览、一键安装与卸载、已装技能列表，以及聊天栏技能选择器。

description.en: One-stop visual management of DSH Skills & MCP: on-demand MCP loading, in-session hot reload, SKILL & MCP descriptions viewable in the plugin.
description.zh: 一站式可视化管理 DSH 的 SKILL 与 MCP：MCP按需加载、会话内热重载、SKILL与MCP描述可在插件内直接查看

description.en: Skill manager page in the DSH Web Settings panel, at the same level as Plugins: lists every skill the installation serves with its own summary, source and disk footprint, and removes any of them into a recoverable trash.
description.zh: DSH Web 设置里的 skill 管理器页面，与「插件」同级：列出当前安装提供的全部 skill 及其自己的简介、来源与占用，并可逐个移除（移除是移入可恢复的回收站）。

description.en: Skill usage scoreboard for DSH: counts both per-session deduplicated and per-load usage, scores `skill` tool calls and direct `read` of skill files, and shows the tally in a three-tab settings page (skill ranking, session board, management) with paging and JSON import/export.
description.zh: DSH 的 Skill 使用记分板：同时记录按会话去重与每次加载两种次数，统计 skill 工具调用与直接 read skill 文件两种记分来源，设置页三选项卡（Skill 排行 / 会话榜 / 管理）展示，支持分页与记分 JSON 导入导出。

description.en: Skill manager for DSH with a pack system. Installs skills as versioned packs and never overwrites files you have edited - upgrades skip your changes and report them. Also ships 6 built-in skills, a problem-grouped settings panel, and tools that let the agent read and write the skill library in conversation.
description.zh: DSH 技能管理器，带技能包机制。技能以带版本的包安装，升级时绝不覆盖你改过的文件，只跳过并如实报告。另自带 6 个基础技能、按「你遇到的问题」分组的面板，以及让模型在对话里直接读写技能库的工具。

description.en: Sidebar skill hub: scan Claude/Codex/Cursor/Gemini skill directories for one-click import, manage global/project skills (toggle, trash), and install from dropped folders, zip archives, or local paths of any size.
description.zh: 侧边栏技能站：扫描 Claude/Codex/Cursor/Gemini 技能目录一键导入，管理全局与项目技能（启停、回收站），支持拖拽文件夹、zip 包与本地路径（不限大小）安装。

description.en: Skill studio for DeepSeek Harness: visualize every agent skill (name, description, source, nested flag, model/user invocation), view and edit the full SKILL.md body, toggle model/user invocation, and mine DSH session logs to extract reusable personal skills that the agent auto-loads — from the web settings panel and via skillmgr_* / skillmgr_extract_* tools.
description.zh: DSH skill 可视化与管理插件：在设置面板列出全部 skill（含来源、嵌套标记与模型/用户调用状态），查看并编辑 SKILL.md 正文，一键启用/禁用模型与用户调用；并可从会话日志提取可复用内容，沉淀为 agent 可自动加载的个人 skill。提供 skillmgr_list/get/save/policy 及 skillmgr_extract_* 工具。

description.en: Read-only Skill inspector for DeepSeek Harness. It shows which Skills a conversation actually loaded — from observed loading evidence only — and which Skills the current environment can discover, and gives each Skill a detail page whose left column switches between the framework, the evidence, validation, evaluation, step evidence, run logic, the before/after of a modification when there is one, the definition facts and the raw SKILL.md. Declaration and run stay apart: the body is split into structure, declared workflow and progressive disclosure, the run logic is read from local receipts, and every declared step carries its own evidence — no observed evidence is reported as exactly that, not as executed or not executed, and the run's instruction hash sits beside the current definition as match, mismatch or unavailable. The evidence view gives each subject one of three states (declared, observed, unavailable), walks definition → load → use → outcome, names what each stage cannot reach, declines to attribute an outcome to the Skill, and can copy the snapshot out as byte-stable JSON. Validation checks the Agent Skills open standard and the platform profiles separately, each finding on a rule id and labelled standard compliance or platform compatibility. Evaluation keeps repeatable cases with the conditions each run was recorded under and the four stages of runtime evidence, comparing two runs of one case item by item without scoring them. The trigger boundary keeps should-trigger and should-not-trigger prompts, has you run them in a real new session, then records what was observed — whether a load record appeared and whether it was model-invoked or user-explicit; a typed /name is not a natural trigger, and an absent load record is reported as not observed, not as not triggered. The same projections are exposed to the agent as a read-only skill_review tool, which returns a structured review packet and says what it omitted when the packet will not fit whole. The inspector, the evidence chain and these reviews are computed on this machine from the definition and the session receipts; the Chinese reading version sends the body through the host's model when you ask for it, keeping code fences, paths and frontmatter verbatim and storing the result on this machine. A Skill can also be cloned into a local copy. It does not write back to the source Skill and does not run its scripts.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的只读 Skill 检视器。它显示一次对话实际加载过哪些 Skill（只凭观测到的加载证据）、当前环境又能发现哪些 Skill，并为每个 Skill 提供一页详情：左列在框架、证据、验收、评测、步骤证据、本次运行逻辑、有修改事务时的本次修改前后对比、定义事实与 `SKILL.md` 原文之间切换。声明与运行始终分开：正文按结构、声明流程与渐进披露拆开，运行逻辑只从本机收据读，每个声明步骤都带自己的证据——没有观测到证据就照实这么写，而不是「已执行」或「未执行」；本次运行收到的指令哈希与当前定义并列给出 match、mismatch 或 unavailable。证据视图给每一类对象三态之一（声明 / 已观察 / 无法取得），沿定义 → 加载 → 使用 → 结果走一遍，逐段写明它够不着什么，不把结果归因给这个 Skill，并能把快照按逐字节稳定的 JSON 复制出去。验收把 Agent Skills 开放标准与各平台 Profile 分开判，每条发现落在规则 id 上并标注「标准合规」或「平台兼容」。评测用可重复的用例记录每次运行的条件与四段运行时证据，只在同一个用例内逐项对照两次运行，不给分。触发边界维护「应触发 / 不应触发」的提示词，由你在真实新会话里跑一遍再记录观察到的结果——加载记录出现过没有、`model-invoked` 还是 `user-explicit`；手打 `/name` 不算自然触发，没有加载记录只写成「未观察到」，不写成「没有触发」。同一批投影也作为只读工具 `skill_review` 交给 Agent，它返回结构化审查包，包太大时会说明省略了什么。检视器、证据链与上面这些审查都在本机按定义与会话收据算；中文阅读版在你需要时把正文交给宿主模型翻译，代码围栏、路径与 frontmatter 逐字保留，译文只存本机。另外可以把一份 Skill 复刻成本机副本。它不改写源 Skill，也不执行源里的脚本。

description.en: Live skill provider that adds skills from 60+ other agents' directories (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot), Claude Code plugin marketplaces, and any git repository of skills to the dsh catalog without copying or symlinking; deduplicates, repairs frontmatter, renames name collisions, and ships a CLI (list, add, sync, doctor).
description.zh: 实时技能提供器：把 60+ 个其他 Agent（Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Gemini CLI、Copilot）的技能目录、Claude Code 插件市场以及任意 git 技能仓库中的技能接入 dsh 目录，零拷贝零软链接；自动去重、修复 frontmatter、处理同名冲突，并附带 CLI（list、add、sync、doctor）。

description.en: Manage DSH skills and commands from Settings: list, enable/disable, edit, delete and add skills across global and project scopes, and save reusable prompts as slash commands.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中管理技能与命令：跨全局与项目作用域查看、启用/停用、编辑、删除与添加技能，并把常用提示词保存为斜杠命令。

description.en: Manage, discover, install, update, and uninstall DSH skills as plugins.
description.zh: 类 Codex 插件市场的 DSH 技能管理器。

description.en: Skin author workbench: official token browser (169 --dsw-* variables with Chinese descriptions and module-usage tags), live try-on, durable skin save, theme freeze, seven spectrum presets with SVG backdrops and custom backdrop upload.
description.zh: 皮肤作者工作台：官方 token 浏览器（169 个 --dsw-* 变量，带中文描述与模块标签）、实时试穿、皮肤持久保存、主题固化、7 套光谱预设与 SVG 背景图，以及自定义背景上传。

description.en: Skin manager for the DSH web GUI: discovers installed skins and switches the active one from a dedicated Settings page, mutually exclusive, hot-reloaded without restart.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 皮肤管理器：自动发现已安装皮肤，在独立设置页一键互斥切换，热载入无需重启。

description.en: Picks a random installed skin on every DeepSeek Harness launch and enables exactly that skin, with an on/off switch and a shuffle action inside the Skins settings page. Skins the running host would refuse to load are excluded, and a manual switch still applies until the next launch.
description.zh: 每次启动 DeepSeek Harness 时随机启用一个已安装皮肤，并在「设置 → 皮肤」页内提供开关与「立即随机换一个」按钮。宿主会拒绝加载的皮肤自动排除；手动切换的皮肤一直有效到下次启动。

description.en: A settings-panel skin manager that auto-discovers installed Web UI skins, switches between them in one click, and maintains the profile patch automatically.
description.zh: 设置面板皮肤管理器：自动扫描已安装的 Web UI 皮肤并一键切换，profile 补丁自动维护。

description.en: Adds two switchable themes, built-in and local-folder background slideshows, and per-session token usage details to DeepSeek Harness Web and Desktop.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 与桌面端提供两套可切换主题、内置及本地文件夹背景轮播和逐会话 Token 用量明细。

description.en: Schedule-send button and panel to the right of the composer, with smart time slots, a custom date/time picker, several queued sends at once, and localStorage persistence that restores pending tasks after a page reload.
description.zh: 在输入框右侧提供「定时发送」按钮与配置面板，支持智能时段、自定义日期时间、多个定时任务并行，任务经 localStorage 持久化，刷新页面后自动恢复。

description.en: Ship a local DSH plugin project to GitHub and the plugin market in one call: preflight, per-file upload with byte verification, the market registry PR, then pull every published file back and compare bytes.
description.zh: 一条命令把本地 DSH 插件工程发到 GitHub 并开市场收录 PR：逐文件上传带字节校验、市场条目 PR，最后把线上文件逐个拉回来比 sha256。

description.en: Smart calendar and checklist assistant with lunar dates, macOS/Windows native notifications, and WeCom push.
description.zh: 智能日程与待办助手：农历节气、macOS/Windows 原生桌面弹窗、企微多平台推送与拖拽改期。

description.en: Wakes the main agent after any DSH restart so interrupted work resumes automatically — adds a restart tool and an optional canary that validates the boot and aborts with an alert before a broken restart.
description.zh: DSH 重启后唤醒主 agent，让被打断的工作自动接着做；提供一个重启工具，以及可选的探针在启动异常时提前中止并告警。

description.en: Smooth comet-mode animated caret for the DSH Web composer: a glowing comet trail replaces the native blinking caret and glides across the input as you type, with configurable accent color, thickness, and trail, IME-aware for CJK input.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 输入框提供流畅的彗星光标：以发光的彗星拖尾取代原生闪烁光标，随输入平滑滑动，可配置强调色、粗细与拖尾，并适配中文等 IME 输入。

description.en: Comet-mode animated caret for the DSH Web composer: a glowing trail glides to the text position, with configurable accent color, thickness, trail, and a 500 ms idle blink. Extends the surface to ask-question card inputs, and fixes the caret vanishing on an empty composer or first focus, forward drag-selection not following the pointer, soft line breaks measuring against the previous line, and the caret painting outside the composer when long input scrolls. Maintained fork of Lacquervii/smooth-cursor.
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框的彗星光标：发光拖尾随文字位置平滑滑动，可配置强调色、粗细、拖尾，并在静止 500ms 后呼吸。覆盖 ask-question 交互卡片的输入框，并修复空输入框或首次聚焦时光标消失、正向拖选不跟随鼠标、软换行按上一行测量、长内容滚动时光标绘制到输入框之外等问题。Lacquervii/smooth-cursor 的维护分支。

description.en: Fluid streaming rendering and smooth scrolling for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供流畅流式渲染和丝滑滚动。

description.en: Read-only SonarQube Community Build tools: instance status, project Quality Gate for a branch or pull request, issue and Security Hotspot search, single hotspot detail, and coverage, duplication or caller-selected measures. Issue and hotspot results carry a normalized location with component key, file path, line and text range.
description.zh: 面向 SonarQube Community Build 的只读工具：实例状态、分支或 PR 的项目质量阈、议题与安全热点搜索、单个热点详情，以及覆盖率、重复率或调用方指定的度量项。议题与热点结果附带标准化的位置信息，包含组件 key、文件路径、行号与文本范围。

description.en: Thinking-sorting plugin. A switch beside the composer puts the session into a three-stage mode — sort, critique, research — and each stage has a checklist of what it should produce before you press the advance button; finished ideas are filed by genre into Settings → Thoughts Center. A floating notebook holds half-formed sparks and opens a new session with the chosen one already written into the input box.
description.zh: 梳理思路插件。输入框旁的开关把会话切进「梳理 → 批判 → 调研」三段模式，每段列着这一段该产出的东西，够了再点「推进」按钮换段；成稿按体裁存进 设置 → Thoughts Center。另有悬浮随想记录本，碎灵感先存着，点「去研究」直接开一条新对话，那句话已经写进输入框。

description.en: Event sounds for DSH: plays a chosen sound on session end, options popup, permission request and stop, with AI-generated character voice lines and a manageable sound library.
description.zh: DSH 声音工坊：在会话结束、弹出选项、请求许可与停止时播放指定音效，支持 AI 角色语音生成与音效库管理。

description.en: Shows a Spark Scope card at the bottom of the dsh sidebar: model server decode and prefill rates with sparklines, running and queued requests, KV cache, TTFT and TPOT p95, and GPU temperature, power, load and memory for each DGX Spark node. Read-only; needs a running Spark Scope server. Works in dsh web and the desktop app.
description.zh: 在 dsh 侧边栏底部显示 Spark Scope 卡片：模型服务的 decode 与 prefill 速率及走势图、运行中与排队请求、KV 缓存、TTFT 与 TPOT p95，以及每个 DGX Spark 节点的 GPU 温度、功耗、负载和显存。只读，需要已运行的 Spark Scope 服务。dsh web 与桌面应用均可使用。

description.en: Adds specification artifacts, skills, commands, goal-backed implementation, and task-progress context.
description.zh: 增加规格工件、技能、命令、由 goal 驱动的实施流程和任务进度上下文。

description.en: Token usage and estimated spend for the dsh web UI: floating panel with per-model, per-day, and per-session stats.
description.zh: DSH Web 用量与费用统计插件：右下角悬浮窗，按模型/按天/按会话多维聚合与预计花费。

description.en: Windows one-click launcher with a borderless WPF startup animation (stroke-by-stroke HARNESS lettering) that starts dsh web in the background and fades into the GUI once ready, plus a desktop_launch tool.
description.zh: Windows 一键启动器：无边框 WPF 启动动画（HARNESS 逐笔描边），后台拉起 dsh web 并在 GUI 就绪后淡入，附 desktop_launch 工具。

description.en: Split-screen workspace for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI - chat with several agents side by side in panes that look and behave exactly like the stock conversation: drag-to-split, live sessions with queued messages and in-pane ask_user/approval cards, per-pane view tabs (Chat/Trajectory/plugin views), a compact TUI composer mode (Alt+T) and pane-focus shortcuts. Requires DSH 0.1.5+.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页端分屏工作区 - 多个会话并排聊天，面板观感与原生对话完全一致：拖拽分屏、实时会话（排队消息、面板内 ask_user/审批卡片）、面板内视图标签（Chat/Trajectory/插件视图）、Alt+T 紧凑 TUI 输入模式与面板焦点快捷键。需要 DSH 0.1.5+。

description.en: Split the DSH conversation area into unlimited native panes — side by side, stacked, 2×2 and an automatic grid — each a real session with its own composer, streaming and approvals.
description.zh: 把 DSH 对话区拆成任意数量的原生窗格：左右、上下、田字 2×2 与自动网格，每个窗格都是独立会话。

description.en: LLM debug console for DeepSeek Harness: captures the full content of every model call at the llm/stream waterfall (options, stream chunks, usage, wire protocol) and shows it in a DevTools-style docked panel, with shared-prefix context diffing, wire-JSON reconstruction, JSON export and a runtime-tunable capture policy.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 里的 LLM 调试台：在 llm/stream 层完整捕获每次模型调用（请求参数、流式块、用量、真实 wire 协议），以 DevTools 风格停靠面板展示，支持上下文共享前缀折叠对比、wire JSON 重建、JSON 导出与运行时可调的抓取策略。

description.en: Store SSH hosts in an AES-256-GCM vault and let the agent run commands on them by alias, with passwords handed to ssh through SSH_ASKPASS instead of the command line. Windows only.
description.zh: 把 SSH 主机存进 AES-256-GCM 加密保险库，智能体按别名执行命令，口令经 SSH_ASKPASS 交给 ssh 而不进入命令行。仅支持 Windows。

description.en: One-click start/stop launcher for DSH Web on macOS — start (foreground/daemon), stop, status, duplicate-launch guard, auto browser open, plus a Dock-able DSH.app built by script.
description.zh: macOS 上 DSH Web 的一键启停启动器：前台/后台启动、停止、状态、防重复启动、自动打开浏览器，并可用脚本构建程序坞版 DSH.app。

description.en: Boot-time guard that repairs corrupt session logs, preflights plugin composition, vm-checks client artifacts, smoke-tests host apply() and quarantines crash-causing bundles, so a broken plugin can never brick startup.
description.zh: 启动守卫：修复会话日志、预检插件组合、校验客户端工件、冒烟宿主 apply() 并隔离崩溃源，让坏插件再也无法砖掉启动。

description.en: Configurable statistics row below the composer via a ${variable} display template — which segments appear and how they are labelled is fully user-defined.
description.zh: 用 ${变量} 显示模板自定义输入框下方的会话统计行——显示哪些统计段、单位文案怎么写，全部由模板决定。

description.en: Quick sticky notes with colored labels, pin, timed reminders, and password protection for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 泡泡猫的即时便签 — 支持彩色标签、置顶、定时提醒与密码保护。

description.en: Opens STL meshes in the right-Sidebar document preview: binary/ASCII parsing in the browser, a WebGL viewport, and size, volume, surface-area and watertightness statistics.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏文档预览里打开 STL：浏览器解析二进制/ASCII 网格，用 WebGL 视口展示尺寸、体积、表面积与水密性。

description.en: Turns stock names and codes in DSH output text into clickable buttons for quotes and company news.
description.zh: 将 DSH 输出文本中的股票名称和代码转换为可点击按钮，并在侧边栏展示行情与资讯。

description.en: Service control panel in DSH Web settings: live host info (PID, versions, uptime, memory/CPU trends, active sessions), npm update banner, and a confirm-guarded graceful stop that warns when tasks are running and can wait for them to finish.
description.zh: DSH Web 设置页的服务控制面板：实时宿主信息（PID、版本、运行时长、内存/CPU 趋势、活跃会话）、npm 更新提醒，以及带确认的优雅停止——任务运行时发出警告，也可等待任务结束后自动停止。

description.en: Plugin store: npm authoritative catalog + awesome curated list (550+ plugins, 11 categories), dsh-field quality verification, official `dsh plugin add/remove` one-click install, sidebar + settings entry.
description.zh: dsh 插件商店：npm 权威目录 + awesome 精选（550+ 插件、11 分类）、dsh 字段质量验证、官方 `dsh plugin add/remove` 一键安装，侧边栏与设置页入口。

description.en: Story Mode preset for DeepSeek Harness: role-play GM persona, three-way choices, .md character cards and world book, context distillation and prompt wrapping.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的故事模式预设：叙事 GM 人格、三条走向、.md 角色卡与世界书记忆、上下文提纯与前后置提示词。

description.en: Session minimap in the scrollbar gutter: to-scale bands coloured by event kind, anchor dots for user messages and failures, auto-loading history at the top, a hover wall of every prompt in the session, and a three-step map scale switcher.
description.zh: 滚动条槽位里的会话缩略图：按事件类型着色的等比色块、用户与失败锚点、滚到顶自动补载历史、悬停线索墙铺开全部发言，附近/中/全三档地图尺度切换。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness streaming MCP bridge: live session events as MCP progress, plus ACP adapter for cc-connect/Feishu.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 流式 MCP 桥接：将实时会话事件作为 MCP 进度输出，并提供 cc-connect/飞书 ACP 适配器。

description.en: Study coach for DeepSeek Harness: turns a course into a knowledge map of subject, module and unit, records mastery per unit in six stages, plans daily tasks against a materials index, keeps a wrong-answer book and spaced-repetition cards, and serves its own web panel.
description.zh: DSH 的学习教练：把一门课拆成知识地图（大类 / 模块 / 最小单元），逐单元记六档掌握度，按资料索引排每日任务，带错题本与记忆卡，并自带一个网页面板。

description.en: Theme studio for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: eight switchable preset styles, accent and panel-translucency fine-tuning, host-side wallpapers painted on the first frame, and a one-click fix when the wallpaper-engine glass tint greys out light styles.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 主题工坊：可切换预设风格、强调色与面板透明度微调、宿主壁纸首帧绘制；wallpaper-engine 玻璃色把浅色主题洗灰时一键改为白色玻璃。

description.en: Runs the official Google Antigravity CLI (agy) as a one-shot coding subagent over print-mode stream-json, exposed as the subagent_antigravity delegation tool. Includes Gemini 4 Argon on Antigravity subscriptions. Requires the Antigravity CLI (agy 1.4+) installed and signed in.
description.zh: 把 Google 官方 Antigravity CLI（agy）作为一次性编码子智能体接入 DeepSeek Harness，提供 subagent_antigravity 委派工具，可直接使用 Gemini 4 Argon 等 Antigravity 订阅模型。需安装并登录 Antigravity CLI（agy 1.4+）。

description.en: Three tools that let any agent, including a team member, list, steer and stop the subagents it started.
description.zh: 三个工具，让任意智能体（包括团队成员）能列出、追问并中止自己派出的子代理。

description.en: Counts the subagent sessions a conversation spawned and shows their token usage and CNY cost in the composer dock, grouped by parent turn.
description.zh: 在输入框工具条上统计本会话派出的子智能体 token 用量与人民币花费，按 turn 分组。

description.en: Subagent model control: a Jev classifier labels each turn, and the subagent request itself is rewritten to the provider, model and reasoning effort that the label maps to, at the agent/request hook; a per-session inherit/auto/manual selector, one prompt per role injected ahead of the task, and offline replay of past verdicts.
description.zh: 子代理模型管控：由 Jev 判定本轮任务类别，再把子代理自身的请求改写为该类别对应的 provider、model 与推理强度（在 agent/request 钩子上执行）；会话内可用继承/自动/手动三种方式指定模型，每个角色可带一条先于任务注入的前置提示词，并可离线回放历史判定。

description.en: Ships a skill about handing work to subagents instead of doing it inline - which tasks are worth fanning out, how many to run at once, how to send them in parallel, and how to check what they returned instead of trusting the summary.
description.zh: 携带一份讲「什么该交给子 agent 做、而不是自己顺手做」的技能——哪些任务值得扇出、一次派几个、并行怎么发，以及子 agent 回来后怎么核对它真的做了什么，而不是信它的总结。

description.en: Dispatch subagents with named profiles (model, reasoning effort, and tool scope per task), safety checks, cost estimation with savings comparison, and a full dispatch decision ledger.
description.zh: 子 Agent 派发插件：按任务选模型、推理强度与工具范围，存成命名方案随时复用；内置安全检查、成本估算与节省分析、完整派发决策台账。

description.en: Lets a text-only DeepSeek agent read images in the same session by delegating to a vision-capable subagent, with send-time image-to-path conversion.
description.zh: 让纯文本 DeepSeek 代理在同一会话内读图：委派给视觉子代理，发送时自动把图片转为文件路径。

description.en: Automatically continues a native continuable DSH subagent once when it ends with explicit max-tokens termination, then stops.
description.zh: 当原生可续接 DSH 子代理因明确的 max-tokens 终止时自动续接一次，然后停止介入。

description.en: Clickable next-step suggestions under every reply; one click sends that sentence as your message.
description.zh: 在每条回复下方给出可点的下一步建议，点一下就把那句话作为你的消息发出去。

description.en: Survival mode: all sessions share one satiety/health pool — each model step burns satiety, starvation freezes tool calls until fed, with an MC mini-game for gathering food.
description.zh: 生存模式：全局共享一条饱食度与生命，模型每步思考消耗饱食度，饿死后全局工具被冻结，通过 MC 采集小游戏获取食物喂食复活。

description.en: Registers two MCP servers that drive the installed AutoCAD and SolidWorks desktop apps over COM, plus two on-demand skills. Windows only, Python 3.11+; the pinned upstream servers install themselves on first load, and only the sides whose CAD application is registered get a row. Each server advertises two meta-tools instead of its full catalog (a discovery shim here for SolidWorks, upstream DISCOVERY_MODE=search for AutoCAD), taking the schemas loaded before the first request from 23,404 to 256 tokens and from 83,732 to 365 respectively.
description.zh: 注册两个 MCP 服务器，在 Windows 上通过 COM 驱动本机安装的 AutoCAD 与 SolidWorks，另附两个按需技能。仅 Windows，需要 Python 3.11+；首次加载时自动安装钉死版本的上游服务器，并且只给真正装了的 CAD 应用注册对应的那一行。两者都只广告两个元工具而非完整工具表（SolidWorks 用本仓库的 discovery 垫片，AutoCAD 用上游 DISCOVERY_MODE=search），首次请求前加载的工具定义分别从 23,404 降到 256 token、从 83,732 降到 365 token。

description.en: Device channel between the agent and your own phone: it sends files it just produced, and you @-reference what your phone sent back. End-to-end encrypted P2P through the SwarmDrop CLI, with no account and no public IP; node status, paired devices and QR pairing sit in a sidebar panel.
description.zh: 在 agent 和你自己的手机之间开一条设备通道：agent 把刚产出的文件发过去，手机传回来的东西可以在输入框里 @ 引用。底层经 SwarmDrop CLI 走端到端加密的 P2P，不需要账号，也不需要公网 IP；节点状态、已配对设备与扫码配对都在侧边栏面板里。

description.en: Adds customizable switch shortcut buttons to the left of the DSH Web GUI chat input for one-click slash-command insertion.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 聊天输入框左侧添加可自定义的 switch 快捷按钮，一键插入斜杠命令。

description.en: Command DeepSeek Harness from Telegram and Feishu (Lark): one live progress message per turn, approvals and questions as buttons, files and voice, delivery that survives outages and restarts, QR setup for Feishu, and per-person roles.
description.zh: 在 Telegram 和飞书中指挥 DeepSeek Harness：每轮一条实时进度消息，按钮审批与提问，收发文件和语音，断线和重启不丢消息，飞书扫码接入，按人设置权限。

description.en: Policy-driven Git sync for DSH settings and profile configuration, with secret-aware projections, conflict review, and per-line apply controls.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 设置与 Profile 配置的策略化 Git 同步，支持敏感信息隔离、冲突审阅与按行选择应用。

description.en: A port of the T3 Code model picker into the composer: a provider rail, search results grouped under provider headings, favorites kept in the browser, unavailable-provider badges, and Cmd/Ctrl+1..9 jump shortcuts for the first nine rows of the visible list.
description.zh: 把 T3 Code 的模型选择器移植到 DSH 输入框：提供方侧栏、按提供方分组的搜索结果、浏览器本地收藏、不可用提供方标记，以及用 Cmd/Ctrl+1..9 直接选中可见列表的前九行。

description.en: A T3 Code-style New Session screen for the composer: a "What should we build in <project>?" headline whose project name opens a workspace menu, a reasoning-effort picker in the composer tool row, and a git branch strip under the card that searches local and remote refs and switches with git checkout.
description.zh: 把 T3 Code 的新会话界面移植到 DSH 输入框：标题「What should we build in <project>?」里的项目名可点开工作区菜单，工具栏里新增推理强度选择器，卡片下方新增 git 分支条，可搜索本地与远程引用并用 git checkout 切换。

description.en: Session-context surfaces ported from T3 Code: a session-row hover card showing machine, git branch, model, agent preset, approval policy and token usage, a status pill covering pending approval, awaiting input, working, error and subagent work, a provider and model chip, a per-session header strip, a lineage breadcrumb, row-menu actions that copy the context or run DSH compaction, and a preference row in DSH Settings for choosing which facts appear. Nothing is added to the composer.
description.zh: 移植 T3 Code 的会话上下文界面：会话行悬浮卡显示机器、Git 分支、模型、代理预设、审批策略与 token 用量，状态标签覆盖待审批、等待输入、运行中、错误与子代理工作，另有提供方与模型标记、会话头部信息条、血缘面包屑、可复制上下文或执行 DSH 压缩的行菜单操作，以及位于 DSH 设置中用于选择显示哪些事实的偏好行。输入框区域不新增任何元素。

description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness control of the Tabbit Browser: auto-loads the tabbit-browser skill on install, detects official Tabbit and Tabbit Browser releases (>= 1.9.0), checks the tabbit-cli persistent runtime, diagnoses the per-platform DSH sandbox mode needed to call the CLI, and downloads the region-matched official installer via a background job when no qualifying version is present.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 能够控制 Tabbit 浏览器：安装即自动加载 tabbit-browser skill，检测国际版 Tabbit 与国内版 Tabbit Browser 正式版（>= 1.9.0），检查 tabbit-cli 常驻运行时，按平台诊断调用 CLI 所需的 DSH sandbox 模式，并在没有合格版本时通过后台任务下载与系统地区匹配的正式版安装包。

description.en: Learns what you leave unsaid in your prompts from messy turns and your own corrections, and injects the learned directives into the system prompt of every new conversation; the directives are editable in Settings and a composer button rewrites the current draft with them.
description.zh: 从不顺的轮次和你自己的纠正中学习你在提示词里没说出口的东西，并把学到的指令注入每个新对话的系统提示；指令可在设置中编辑，输入框按钮可用它们改写当前草稿。

description.en: Tailscale remote-access operations panel for the dsh web GUI: health checks, HTTPS entry toggle via tailscale serve, macOS proxy bypass, relay server ops, and ACL snippet generation.
description.zh: Tailscale 远程访问运维面板：健康检查、HTTPS 入口（tailscale serve）开关、macOS 代理绕过、中继服务器运维与 ACL 片段生成。

description.en: Per-request cost ledger covering retries and subagents, holiday-aware peak/off-peak pricing, shared pricing/usage/balance/budget services, and DeepSeek bill reconciliation.
description.zh: 按请求记录费用，涵盖重试与子代理，支持节假日峰谷计价、共享计价/用量/余额/预算服务和 DeepSeek 账单对账。

description.en: Cost readouts for the composer, turns and sessions, a usage dashboard, daily/monthly budgets and settings, with DeepSeek balance from dsh-tally-balance-deepseek.
description.zh: 提供输入框费用条、每轮与会话费用详情、用量看板、日/月预算和设置，并通过 dsh-tally-balance-deepseek 显示 DeepSeek 余额。

description.en: Unofficial upstream bundle for DeepSeek Harness. CodeBuddy gateway with a runtime-synced model catalogue, per-model reasoning efforts, web search/fetch, image generation and a streaming credential bridge, plus TraeWork CN and Qoder CN subscription channels via local translation gateways and a key-type OpenAI-compatible provider registry, all managed from an accordion settings card.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的非官方上游插件包：CodeBuddy 网关（模型目录动态同步、逐模型思考强度、联网搜索/抓取、生图、流式凭据桥），TraeWork CN 与 Qoder CN 两条订阅额度通道（本地 OpenAI 翻译网关），以及 key 型 OpenAI 兼容上游注册表，全部收在四区块手风琴设置卡里。

description.en: Flip the DSH page over to a glass task board showing live jobs, subagents and session state, with an infinite canvas that unrolls a card into draggable controls, embedded web-app frames, and a conversation box that edits the canvas.
description.zh: 把 DSH 页面翻到背面变成玻璃任务台（会话 / 后台任务 / 子代理 / 工作区卡片），并提供无限画布：能把卡片拆成可拖动的控件、内嵌网页应用，还能用对话框直接改画布。

description.en: Scheduled task dispatcher: a dsh host plugin that drives recurring agent tasks from a single task table, dispatching each run as an independent dsh session; scheduling is pure logic and uses zero model calls.
description.zh: 定时任务调度器：一张任务表驱动周期性运行的 agent 任务，每次调度为一个独立的 dsh 会话；调度本身纯逻辑实现，不消耗任何模型调用。

description.en: TickTick (滴答清单) daily task dispatcher: an interval timer pulls due tasks from a chosen list into a Markdown task file and notifies only when the task set changes (WeChat via ClawBot / flomo / macOS); it can also auto-execute each task in its own headless DSH session under a configurable timeout, optionally gated to DeepSeek's off-peak hours so peak-time work queues to the next off-peak window instead of starting, plus a settings panel for the deferred write-back queue and dispatcher_status / dispatcher_config / dispatcher_run / dispatcher_report tools.
description.zh: 滴答清单任务派发器：按间隔从指定清单拉取到期任务写入今日任务文件，仅在任务集变化时通知（微信 ClawBot / flomo / macOS）；可为每个任务单独开一个 headless DSH 会话自动执行（worker 超时可配），并可选只在 DeepSeek 空闲（优惠）时段开跑——高峰期把任务排到下个空闲窗口而不是立刻执行；带 Web 设置面板（延迟回写队列、省钱模式时段与状态）与 dispatcher_status / dispatcher_config / dispatcher_run / dispatcher_report 工具。

description.en: Auto-adjust model reasoning effort per task (off/low/high/max): task classification, \[effort=...] markers, in-turn error escalation, DeepSeek peak-pricing-period capping with countdown notices, and manual-selection priority.
description.zh: 根据任务自动调整模型推理档位（off/low/high/max）：任务分类判定、\[effort=...] 显式标记、轮内出错升级、DeepSeek 高峰计价时段自动限档省钱并显示切换倒计时、GUI 手动选择优先。

description.en: Live session status on the browser tab favicon with sound notifications for pending input and completed tasks.
description.zh: 浏览器标签页 Favicon 实时回显会话状态，并支持需介入/已完成时的音效提示。

description.en: Adds a Graph tab that renders one session's execution as an interactive DAG of turns, LLM steps, tools, skills, subagents, code changes and tests, with live status, retry aggregation, critical path and trajectory linkage.
description.zh: 在会话区新增「图谱」Tab，把单个会话的执行过程渲染为可交互 DAG：轮次、LLM 步骤、工具、技能、子代理、代码改动与测试，支持实时状态、重试聚合、关键路径与轨迹双向联动。

description.en: Web mascot that acts out each live tool call (read, write, edit, search, run, plan, sub-agent, wait, error) with matching step cards in chat; ships two swappable character packs.
description.zh: 跟随 Agent 每一次工具调用（读、写、改、搜、运行、规划、子代理、等待、出错）实时切换动作的网页吉祥物，并在对话中显示对应步骤卡片；内置两套可切换角色包。

description.en: Adds a "Task Planning" agent preset that asks requirements in versioned rounds, then writes step-by-step plans and prompts without implementing them itself.
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加「任务规划」模式：按版本迭代逐轮提问把需求问清楚，再产出可逐条执行的规划与提示词，自身不实现代码。

description.en: Live progress for long-running DSH tasks: a script appends JSON lines to a per-session progress file, the Web UI draws them in a floating overlay and a right-sidebar tab that also lists background jobs which reported nothing, and `dsh-progress run -- <cmd>` wraps a command that cannot report for itself.
description.zh: DSH 长任务的实时进度：脚本往该会话自己的进度文件追加 JSON 行，不能自报进度的命令可用 `dsh-progress run -- <cmd>` 包装，Web 界面用悬浮窗与右侧栏 tab 展示，未上报的后台任务也会列成任务行。

description.en: Task reliability: auto-retry on model timeouts/failures, auto-continue unfinished tasks, completion verification, thinking-repeat interruption, resume after sleep or restart, autopilot mode and a remote trigger endpoint (npm: `dsh-task-reliability`).
description.zh: 任务可靠性：模型超时/请求失败自动重试、任务未完成自动继续、独立完成度校验、思考重复检测打断、休眠/重启后任务自动恢复、自主决策模式、远程触发接口（npm: `dsh-task-reliability`）。

description.en: Project/task dual-mode workspaces for DSH: a task skips the workspace picker and gets a fresh scratch directory (D:\dsh_working\<name>-<timestamp>) per conversation, Codex-style; no-workspace sessions are grouped under a persistent Tasks section in the sidebar with empty states, and the new-session workspace picker gains a "no workspace (task)" option.
description.zh: DSH 项目/任务双模式工作区：任务不绑定工作区，每次新对话在 D:\dsh_working\<名称>-<时间戳> 自动创建独立临时目录（类 Codex）；侧边栏"任务"分组常驻显示所有无工作区会话并带空状态提示，新建会话的工作区选择器增加"无工作区（任务）"选项。

description.en: Turn-level workspace undo for Git worktrees: every agent turn gets a private snapshot, /undo previews a red/green diff card that is confirmed in place, files changed after the turn are refused with a conflict diff unless --force or --skip-conflicts is passed, and HEAD, index, stash and commit history of the user repository are never written.
description.zh: Git worktree 的 turn 级工作区撤销：每个 turn 建私有快照，/undo 先出红绿 diff 预览卡、卡内确认；turn 之后被改过的文件拒绝用冲突 diff 覆盖，只有显式 --force 或 --skip-conflicts 才继续；不写用户仓库的 HEAD、index、stash 与提交历史。

description.en: Tavily web search for DSH with a settings toggle, keyless by default, and a connection test.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Tavily 网页搜索：设置开关、默认无 Key，以及连通测试。

description.en: Connects the Tavily hosted MCP server and registers the tools it publishes. The API key is read from the TAVILY_API_KEY credential and is not stored in plugin config.
description.zh: 接入 Tavily 托管的 MCP 服务器并注册它公布的工具。API Key 从 TAVILY_API_KEY 凭据读取，不写入插件配置。

description.en: Takes over the built-in web_search and web_fetch providers with Tavily, each behind its own toggle: a key pool with balance-aware scheduling that reads real credit balances from /usage, failover with hard exclusion of cooling or exhausted keys, and call history with a 14-day credit chart.
description.zh: 用 Tavily 接管内置的 web_search 与 web_fetch 提供方，两者各有一个开关：密钥池按余额调度（从 /usage 读取真实余额），失败自动切换，冷却中与额度耗尽的密钥硬排除，并记录调用历史与 14 天额度图表。

description.en: Alpha Agent Teams plugin for DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 and newer that lets same-session user Steer end the Lead’s current wait_agent call while teammates continue, with native message delivery and Node PTC continuation.
description.zh: 适用于 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 起版本的 Agent Teams 预览插件，让同会话用户 Steer 结束主代理当前的 wait_agent 等待，队友继续工作，并保留原生消息领取与 Node PTC 后续执行。

description.en: Adjust Agent Team's member count, task count, message size and teardown timeout.
description.zh: 调整 Agent Team 的人数、任务数、单条消息大小与清理超时。

description.en: Persistent, cross-session multi-agent team rooms for DeepSeek Harness — members, a message bus, a shared task board, and a shared timeline that survive restarts.
description.zh: 持久化、跨会话的多 Agent 团队房间：成员、消息总线、共享任务板与共享时间线，重启后仍然保留。

description.en: One-way Telegram notifications for DSH.
description.zh: 针对 DSH 的单向 Telegram 通知。

description.en: Redacts supported secret patterns from the `session-telemetry/record` export copy before configured telemetry backends receive it.
description.zh: 在已配置遥测后端接收前，对 `session-telemetry/record` 导出副本中的已支持秘密模式进行脱敏。

description.en: A temp note in the DSH right sidebar with session, workspace, and global scopes, browser-local autosave, one-click copy, and one-click LLM polish through the default model.
description.zh: DSH 右侧边栏的临时笔记，支持会话级、工作区级与全局三种范围、自动保存、一键复制，以及用默认模型一键优化为 Markdown。

description.en: Tender search and bid intelligence in DeepSeek Harness with proposed project search, rule screening, human review and Excel/PDF exports using user-authorized Qichacha MCP.
description.zh: 招投标智能体：支持招投标搜索、招标查询、投标查询、标讯查询、拟建项目与项目筛选，辅助商机发现、人工复核及 Excel/PDF 导出，使用客户自备授权的企查查 MCP。

description.en: Adds a "Terms" action to finished assistant answers that explains the computer-science terms it detects with Chinese definitions, occurrence counts, highlighted context snippets, and clickable nested explanations from a built-in offline dictionary, with no model calls.
description.zh: 在每条已完成回答的操作条增加「术语」入口，用内置离线词典给出回答中计算机术语的中文释义、提及次数、高亮上下文，并支持点击释义中的术语展开次级解释，不调用模型。

description.en: Select a term in a DeepSeek Harness conversation and press the Search button beside it to read the explanation in place: basic meaning, purpose and usage, with the token cost of that answer. The call is auxiliary — it writes nothing to the session log.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话里选中一个术语、点旁边的「搜索」按钮，就地解释基本含义、用途与用法，并显示这次回答消耗的 token；该调用是旁路调用，不写入会话日志。

description.en: Real PTY terminal panel for the DSH Web UI: host half spawns shells with node-pty (cmd.exe default on Windows), rendered in the browser with xterm.js; multi-tab sessions, dock/floating window, clipboard support.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 终端面板：宿主端 node-pty 真实 PTY（Windows 默认 cmd.exe）+ 浏览器 xterm.js 渲染；多标签会话、停靠/浮动窗口、复制粘贴。

description.en: Choose which shell backs the Windows terminal tool: PowerShell, the local Git Bash, or cmd.exe.
description.zh: 选择 Windows 终端工具背后的 shell：PowerShell、本地 Git Bash 或 cmd.exe。

description.en: Test work framework for DSH that scaffolds a product, module and version directory tree, registers seven test_framework_* tools and four runtime skills, and adds a prompt-level gate that reports which requirement-document splits, versions, related documents and environment credentials are still unrecorded before testing starts. Requires the playwright MCP server (no fallback).
description.zh: DSH 测试工作框架：把空文件夹初始化为产品、模块、版本、报告与归档目录树，注册 7 个 test_framework_* 工具与 4 个运行时技能，并提供提示词级闸门——开测前报告需求文档拆分、版本、跨文档关联与环境账密中尚未登记的部分。需先配置 playwright MCP（无替代路径）。

description.en: On-screen test-progress HUD for DSH — a click-through panel drawn over the app under test, showing each step's expectation vs actual and whether the waiting human may take back the mouse and keyboard. Ships a universal prebuilt binary (arm64 + x86_64), so no Xcode Command Line Tools are needed; the panel itself requires macOS 14+.
description.zh: 把自动测试的进展画在被测界面之上的浮层：每步的期待与实际，以及等待的人现在能不能动鼠标键盘。包内附带通用预编译二进制（arm64 + x86_64），无需 Xcode 命令行工具；浮层面板自身要求 macOS 14 及以上。

description.en: Docker-isolated real-host lifecycle tests for DSH plugins across install, boot, tool registration, update, uninstall, reinstall, and recovery, with structured evidence.
description.zh: 在 Docker 隔离的真实宿主中测试 DSH 插件的安装、启动、工具注册、更新、卸载、重装与恢复生命周期，并输出结构化证据。

description.en: Theme pack for the DSH Web UI: 30 drop-in CSS themes with light and dark variants, integrated into Settings → General with a programmatic API.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 主题包：30 款即插即用的 CSS 主题，每款含浅色与深色变体，集成于「设置 → 通用」，并提供程序化 API。

description.en: Visual theme customizer for the DeepSeek Harness web UI — backgrounds, text colors, borders and details, all adjustable visually, with presets you can import and export, persisted across restarts.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 界面自定义主题插件：背景/文字/框线/细节全可视化调整，可导入导出预设，持久化保存。

description.en: Signature escook theme ported from VS Code: 4 classic aesthetic color schemes (Dark, Dark Soft, Light, Light Soft) with high-contrast syntax highlighting for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 移植自 VS Code 经典的彬哥主题：包含 4 款经典美学配色（经典暗黑、柔和暗黑、紫韵浅色、柔和浅色）与高对比度语法高亮。

description.en: A Honkai: Star Rail "Firefly" theme with wallpaper/video backgrounds, firefly-green neon palette, transformation boot animation, ambient particles, BGM, typewriter SFX, and context-aware emote easter eggs.
description.zh: 崩坏：星穹铁道「流萤」主题：立绘/动态壁纸、萤火绿霓虹配色、开屏变身动画、萤火氛围粒子、背景音乐、打字音效与按对话触发的表情包彩蛋。

description.en: A Herta theme for DeepSeek Harness: an ASCII boot opening ported from the upstream Herta project, a violet palette of design tokens, swappable wallpapers (four bundled, plus image URL, local import, solid colour or off) and a "Herta Appearance" page in DSH settings. Doubles as the theme that dsh-herta ships with.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的黑塔主题：移植自上游 Herta 项目的开机 ASCII 开场、一整套紫罗兰设计令牌、可替换的壁纸（自带四张，也支持图片网址 / 本机导入 / 纯色 / 关掉），以及 DSH 设置里的「黑塔外观」页。它同时就是 dsh-herta 自带的那套主题。

description.en: Two switchable design languages for the DSH GUI — liquid glass with inner-lit surfaces and pointer specular, and Soviet constructivism with cream/ink/red poster geometry — plus a personalization panel, drop-in CSS skin packs, and a seven-expression whale-girl pet.
description.zh: 给 DSH 界面的两套可切换设计语言：内部发光的液态玻璃，与米色/血红/墨黑的苏联构成主义海报；附带个性化面板、投放式 CSS 皮肤包与 7 种表情的鲸鱼娘桌宠。

description.en: Classic Macintosh (System 7) pixel theme: desktop pattern canvas, Finder sidebar, monochrome buttons and dialogs, light/dark support.
description.zh: 经典麦金塔 System 7 像素风主题：桌面网点画布、Finder 侧栏、黑白按钮与弹窗，深浅色随官方外观切换。

description.en: Two-level theme manager for the DSH Web UI: pick a culture / scene, a national flag, a developer palette, or a high-contrast pairing first, then a concrete style (58 built-in palettes, light and dark).
description.zh: DSH Web 两级主题管理器：先选文化 / 场景、国旗、开发者配色或强烈对比配色，再选具体风格，内置 58 套浅色 / 深色配色。

description.en: Path to Nowhere MBCC dossier theme for DSH, with dark and light palettes, a boot splash, a balance capsule and a settings panel.
description.zh: 无期迷途 MBCC 档案风 DSH 主题：深浅两套色板、开屏动画、余额胶囊与设置面板。

description.en: Media-scape theme for the DSH web UI: standing/character-art and video wallpapers (mp4/webm, local + online) with boot animation, base color schemes (single-source JSON + presets + picker), capsule host-element styling, ambient particles, background music player (covers/playlists/random), typing sound effects, and a draggable dock toolbar with a unified upload entry — wallpapers and music uploaded together (suffix-classified), mid-upload no-disk buffering, pause→.part snapshots with offset resume, filename+size dedup with "skipped" notices, and true-delete removal with list refreshes.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 媒体景观主题：立绘/视频壁纸（mp4/webm，本地+在线）+ 开屏动画 + 基底配色（单真源 JSON + 预设包 + 取色器 + 胶囊宿主元素样式）+ 氛围粒子 + 背景音乐播放器（封面/歌单/随机）+ 打字音效 + 可拖动 dock 工具条；dock「传」统一上传壁纸与音乐（按文件后缀识别）——上传中途不落盘、暂停落 .part 快照可续传、文件名+大小去重预检「已跳过」、移除真实删除并前后刷新列表。

description.en: Mineradio glassmorphism theme for the DSH web UI: champagne-gold glass panes, a fluid or wallpaper backdrop, and a one-switch toggle that restores the stock look exactly.
description.zh: Mineradio 玻璃拟态 DSH 网页主题：香槟金玻璃面板、流体或壁纸背景，一键开关即可还原原生界面。

description.en: A token-based DeepSeek Harness theme plugin with ten presets, custom colors, and system font pickers.
description.zh: 基于原生令牌的 DeepSeek Harness 主题插件，提供十套预设、自定义配色与系统字体选择。

description.en: Neo-brutalist theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with paper and ink palettes, 4px hard rules, 8px offset shadows, zero radius, hazard stripes, and an in-settings theme row that restores the factory appearance.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的新粗野主义主题：白纸 / 黑板双配色，4px 硬边、8px 偏移硬阴影、零圆角、警示斜纹，设置页内置主题行，可一键切回出厂外观。

description.en: Song-dynasty-inspired theme for the DSH web UI: a light "rice paper" and a dark "night ink" variant, Ru celadon carrying interactive states while kiln copper is reserved for blockquotes, plus a 4pt spacing scale and a 46-glyph mask icon set.
description.zh: 宋律 Songgrid —— 宋代美学主题，宣纸（浅）与夜墨（深）双变体；汝窑天青承担交互态、窑铜只用于引用块；另附 4pt 间距阶与 46 个 mask 图标。

description.en: Stardew Valley theme (full-skin edition) for the dsh web UI only: replaces the served web frontend with a self-contained pixel-farm interface — Junimo dialog, farm-select presets, quest journal HUD, session-as-day valley calendar, chiptune SFX and desktop pets. Not available in the desktop window and not compatible with other UI-changing plugins.
description.zh: 星露谷物语主题·整皮版，仅适用于 dsh Web 界面：把 Web 前端整体换成自包含的像素农场界面——祝尼魔对话、农场选预设、任务日志 HUD、会话即游戏日的山谷日历、8-bit 音效与桌宠。不支持桌面原生窗口，请勿与其他会改变 UI 的插件同时启用。

description.en: Stripe Style theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a 40px purple grid, layered soft shadows, 12px cards, an 8px control scale, and an in-settings theme row with Daylight Violet and Midnight Navy palettes plus one-click factory restore.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 的 Stripe 风格主题：40px 紫色网格、多级柔和阴影、12px 卡片与 8px 控件圆角，设置页内可直接切换「白昼紫 / 午夜蓝」双版本，并可一键恢复出厂外观。

description.en: Windows XP (Luna) skin for the DSH web GUI: beige Luna panels, gradient buttons, #7F9DB9 input fields, rounded blue scrollbars and a CSS-drawn Bliss-style desktop, plus a chime when a turn finishes and a different cue when the agent stops for approval.
description.zh: 把 DSH 换成 Windows XP：Luna 蓝皮肤（米色面板、渐变按钮、#7F9DB9 输入框、圆角蓝色滚动条、纯 CSS 绘制的 Bliss 风格桌面），外加一轮跑完时的提示音，以及智能体停下来等你批准时的另一种提示音。

description.en: Look & theme plugin for the DSH Web UI: built-in palettes, light/dark/follow-system appearance modes, Open VSX theme search & install, and VS Code theme import with a persisted theme library.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 外观与主题插件：内置调色板、明 / 暗 / 跟随系统外观模式、Open VSX 主题搜索导入与 VS Code 主题导入，主题库持久化。

description.en: Thesis and empirical-analysis workbench that drives IBM SPSS from the conversation: spss_check (environment self-check), spss_variables (list .sav variables with labels, types, measurement levels, case counts), spss_data (sample case rows to inspect missing and outlying values), spss_run / spss_run_file (execute SPSS syntax or an .sps file, relative CD and GET FILE paths auto-rebased), and spss_analyze (one-shot frequencies, descriptives, crosstabs with chi-square, t-tests, one-way ANOVA, correlation, linear regression). Results come back as structured tables extracted through OMS. SPSS 25-31 is auto-detected; the bundled MCP server is zero-dependency stdio.
description.zh: 论文/实证分析工作台：在对话里直接驱动 IBM SPSS。spss_check（环境自检）、spss_variables（列出 .sav 变量：名称/标签/类型/测度水平/案例数）、spss_data（抽查案例数据，检查缺失与异常值）、spss_run 与 spss_run_file（执行 SPSS 语法或 .sps 文件，自动修正 CD / GET FILE 相对路径）、spss_analyze（一键跑频数、描述统计、交叉表卡方、t 检验、单因素方差、相关、线性回归）。结果经 OMS 导出为结构化表格。自动探测 SPSS 25-31；内置 MCP server 为零依赖 stdio 服务。

description.en: Smooth think-row experience for the DSH Web UI: think rows expand as a capped 24-line preview that glides to the bottom while reasoning streams, collapse with a short height animation on settle, and the main conversation view follows with a reader-safe smooth chase (no snaps, no yanks).
description.zh: DSH Web 端的丝滑思考盒体验：think 行展开为 24 行限高预览并随流式推理平滑追底，settle 时以短动画收起，主对话视图以读者友好的平滑追逐跟随（无跳变、无拉扯）。

description.en: Replaces the composer model selector with a "model · reasoning level" trigger: a slider across every level a model reports, three switchable modes (the DSH native selector, a gradient particle rail, an energy-charge track), and a per-provider one-click fill for models that declare no reasoning levels.
description.zh: 把 composer 的模型选择器换成「模型名 · 推理等级」触发区：滑块覆盖模型上报的全部等级，可切换三种模式（DSH 官方原生选择器、渐变粒子轨道、能量充能轨道），并可按代理商一键为未声明等级的模型补齐四档。

description.en: Registers system-prompt sections that make the model reason in Simplified or Traditional Chinese, with strict/prefer modes and an optional reply-language policy. Adds a /thinking-zh command for per-session switching. Zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 注册系统提示词段落，让模型的内部思考使用简体或繁体中文，支持严格/宽松两种强度，并可单独约束最终回复语言。提供 /thinking-zh 命令做会话级切换。零运行时依赖。

description.en: Animated and video live wallpaper for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI — GIF, animated WebP/APNG and static PNG/JPEG images, plus MP4/WebM video backgrounds, with auto format detection, a dim slider, and UI chrome tone matching.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 界面动态壁纸插件：支持 GIF / 动图 WebP / APNG 与静态 PNG/JPG 图片，以及 MP4 / WebM 视频背景，格式自动识别，自带压暗与亮度调节，可让界面色调跟随背景。

description.en: Session-local scheduled tasks: inject a prompt into the current session after a delay, at a fixed time, or on a repeating interval, so the model wakes up and runs it on time. Manage them from a panel above the composer, the /schedule command, or seven model-facing tools. Timers freeze while DSH is closed and never auto-resume; pause keeps the remaining time, so resuming continues from where it stopped.
description.zh: 会话内定时任务：按延迟、固定时刻或重复间隔向当前会话注入一段提示词，到点唤醒模型执行。可用输入框上方面板、/schedule 命令、或 7 个面向模型的工具管理。DSH 关闭期间计时冻结、绝不自动恢复；暂停保留剩余时间，恢复后从原处继续。

description.en: Two-way TickTick/Dida365 (滴答清单) task sync via the official OAuth Open API: pull tasks across lists, create/update/complete/delete tasks, and one-shot title-deduped sync, with a web settings panel.
description.zh: 基于官方 OAuth Open API 双向同步滴答清单（TickTick/Dida365）任务：拉取各清单任务、创建/更新/完成/删除、按标题去重的一键同步，带 Web 设置面板。

description.en: Billing-period and balance pill under the DSH composer: it shows the account balance and the current conversation cost alongside the peak/off-peak state and a countdown to the next switch. The peak/off-peak rules cover China statutory holidays and weekends, and the conversation cost is measured as the decrease in account balance between the plugin's 60-second idle balance refreshes.
description.zh: DSH 输入框下方的计费时段与余额药丸：常显账户余额与本次对话花费，并显示峰价/谷价档位与距下次切换的倒计时。峰谷判定含中国法定节假日与周末；本次对话花费按余额差值记账，采样点是插件自带的「对话停止满一分钟后刷新余额」。

description.en: Tieba (Baidu forum) reader and companion for DSH: reads threads, writes daily digests, signs in, and builds a per-forum style library from high-liked replies. Optional replies to threads or to sub-replies under your own comments are off by default and limited per round and per day. Also ships a read-only MCP server for Codex, AstrBot and Claude Desktop.
description.zh: DSH 泡贴吧插件：读帖、写日报、签到，并从高赞回复里按吧建立风格库；回帖与楼中楼默认关闭，受每轮/每日限额。另带只读 MCP server，可接 Codex、AstrBot、Claude Desktop。

description.en: Rates how hard the current message is and shows the cheapest model and reasoning effort that still fits, above the composer, before you send.
description.zh: 发送前判断问题难度，在输入框上方提示够用的模型与推理等级，避免用错档位多花钱。

description.en: Creates local, content-addressed workspace checkpoints with diff previews and two-phase restore confirmation.
description.zh: 创建本地内容寻址工作区存档，提供差异预览和两阶段确认恢复。

description.en: Turn timer for DSH: reports how long the current turn has been running, injects wrap-up prompts on a /set-time schedule so the agent starts finishing instead of running on, and shows run-time cards above the composer.
description.zh: DSH 本轮计时看门狗：读取本轮已运行时长，按 /set-time 排程向模型注入收尾提示词，并在输入框上方显示运行时长卡片。

description.en: DSH productivity plugin: timeline navigation, prompt library, conversation export, quick notes, and more.
description.zh: DSH 效率插件：时间轴、提示词库、导出对话、闪记等提效功能。

description.en: Turn English audiobooks (MP3) and documents into listening lessons: transcribe every sentence locally with the speech model DSH voice input already downloaded (about 241 MB, fetched on first use if missing; ffmpeg required), proofread and explain each sentence with your DSH model, then drill with blind listening, intensive listening and spaced repetition, with Chinese-dubbing export and offline Kokoro voices; ships a sidebar panel and four AI tools.
